Ajustes de Alfa en todos los idiomas: la.en: Alfa tweaks in every language: dates in each one's own order and every specialization's name right.

Al abrir el buzón, un aviso si una carta.en: When you open the mailbox, a notice if a letter with items expires in less than 3 days.

Al abrirse el mapa de vuelo, vuela al de.en: When the flight map opens, flies to the destination your route marks.

Al acercar o cargar el mapa, cada parte.en: When you zoom in or the map loads, each part appears whole at once, with no loose squares.

Al apuntar a un jefe (y al entrar a una.en: When you target a boss (and when you enter a raid): buff food, a flask or elixir in raids, a healthstone if there's a warlock, and your ammo. A small notice, never in combat.

When building your routes, Alfa leaves out quests with elite enemies: stronger ones, meant for a group.

Al cerrar el modo pesca, cuánto sacaste.en: When you close fishing mode, how much you caught while it was open.

Al comparar objetos, Alfa valora más lo.en: When comparing items, Alfa values what %s asks for: the top of the stats list.

Completing a quest shows in your chat again: "[Quest] is ready to turn in" and "Quest complete!". Turn it on and your group sees it too.

Al curar con un clic, ese compañero qued.en: When you heal with a click, that teammate stays targeted for your other powers.

Al elegir un plan de talentos, las flech.en: When you pick a build, the upgrade arrows in your bags value what that build needs.

Al empezar aturde a quien lo despertó en.en: At the start he stuns whoever woke him at the altar: that's normal.

Al enemigo le queda poca vida: Quemadura.en: The enemy is low on health: Shadowburn finishes it.

Al enemigo le queda poca vida: remátalo.en: The enemy is low on health: finish it instantly.

Al enemigo le queda poca vida: remátalo..en: The enemy is low on health: finish it.

Al entrar a una mazmorra, Lya te da un c.en: When you enter a dungeon, Lya gives you a short tip and a button to see it. Never in combat.

Al entrar a una zona con enemigos muy ar.en: When you enter a zone with enemies far above your level, a short notice (once per zone).

Al entrar al juego, Lya te dice quién de.en: When you log in, Lya tells you who in your guild is online and where.

Al entrar en combate con la caña puesta,.en: When combat starts with your pole equipped, a short notice on how to get back to your weapons.

Al entrar o al juntarse tu grupo reviso.en: When you go in or your group fills up I check your gear, bags, food and class supplies. If something's missing I tell you what and take you to get it. Also with /alfa listo.

Al entrar o al juntarse tu grupo: equipo.en: On entering or when your group fills up: gear, bags, food, water, ammo and your class supplies. Never in combat.

Al entrar solo sale la animación; lo dem.en: At login only the animation plays; the rest waits for you on Today and with Lya.

Al entrar, Alfa tardó %.0f ms en cargar.en: When you logged in, Alfa took %.0f ms to load its files and %.0f ms to start.

Al entrar, su nombre en morado con sus n.en: On the way in, its name in purple with its levels and its bosses. Once every 30 minutes.

Al entregar una misión, Lya te ofrece co.en: When you turn in a quest, Lya offers to tell you how it ended.

Al final de la Tercera Guerra, Arthas su.en: At the end of the Third War, Arthas climbed the Frozen Throne, put on the helm and became one with the Lich King.

Al final de la pelea se enfurece y pega.en: Near the end he enrages and hits faster: save some healing for then.

Al final se enfurece: guarden su mejor d.en: She enrages at the end: save your best damage for the end.

Al final, habla con el Discípulo de Nara.en: At the end, talk to the Disciple of Naralex and protect him as he walks: that brings out the last boss.

Al hablar con el maestro de vuelo, abre.en: Talking to the flight master opens the map directly.

Al hablar con quien da una misión de tu.en: When you talk to someone giving a quest on your route, it's accepted by itself.
When you talk to whoever gives a quest of your route, it is accepted by itself. Shift leaves it to you.

Al hablar con un banquero se abre el ban.en: Talking to a banker opens Alfa's bank, with quick deposit. Each character's first visit shows the game's: that's how it gets its first tab.

Al hurtar a los humanoides ganas monedas.en: Pick-pocketing humanoids gets you coins and sometimes locked boxes.

Al invitar a una comunidad ya no sale el.en: Inviting to a community no longer shows the block warning: Alfa gives you the name ready to copy and opens the window. Your guild is one click, as before.

Al llegar a donde descansas, un anuncio.en: When you reach a place to rest, a calm blue announcement.

Al llegar a una ciudad o posada. También.en: When you reach a town or an inn. It also repeats the guide's training note while the guide window is hidden.

Al llegar a una zona con una mazmorra pa.en: When you reach a zone with a dungeon for your level, Lya tells you who in the pack is nearby and at your level, with "Invite".
When you reach a zone with a dungeon for your level, I tell you who in the pack is nearby and at your level, with "Invite".

Al llegar a una zona, su nombre en grand.en: When you reach a zone, its name in large letters in the colour of whoever holds it, with its levels, and the game's own is hidden so you don't get two. Never on a flight or in combat.

Al llegar en barco o al encontrar un rar.en: When you arrive by boat or find a rare, a big animated announcement, like the intro.

Al morir aparecen cuatro abisarios que c.en: When he dies, four voidwalkers appear and walk through the courtyard together: get ready for several.

Al morir en un campo de batalla, liberas.en: When you die in a battleground, you release your spirit at once.

Al morir llegan muchos aprendices: prepá.en: When he dies many trainees rush in: get ready for lots of enemies at once.

Al moverte, la tecla vuelve a la normal.en: While moving, the key goes back to normal

Al objetivo le queda poca vida: Ejecutar.en: Your target is low on health: Execute finishes it with your rage.

Al objetivo le queda poca vida: el marti.en: Your target is low on health: the hammer finishes it from range.

Al pasar a un pueblo, una mina o un lago.en: When you walk into a village, a mine or a lake, its name. Each one once every 10 minutes.

Al pasar el ratón por un objeto: «Tienes.en: On an item's tooltip: "You have 12 (Lobato: 7 in bags, Alt: 5 in bank)", across all your characters.

Al pasar el ratón por un pin del minimap.en: When you hover a pin on the minimap or the maps: how many yards away it is and in which direction.

Al pasar el ratón sobre un objeto: su pr.en: When you hover an item: its auction price, what a vendor pays and what suits you best.

Al pasar el ratón: cuánto te falta para.en: On mouseover: how much you need for the next rank and about how many quests that is.

Al pasar el ratón: en cuánto subes de ni.en: On mouseover: how soon you level up at your pace, what your finished quests give and your rest.

Al pie de Cima del Trueno está el poblad.en: At the foot of Thunder Bluff lies Bloodhoof Village, where Baine, Cairne's son, looks after his people.

Al poner algo a la venta en la subasta:.en: When you put something up for sale at the auction house: its suggested price, its 14-day history and a warning if you sell it too cheap.

Al recibir daño suelta pedazos más peque.en: As it takes damage it breaks off smaller shards: kill them with area attacks.

Al salir de cada combate te pongo «%s»..en: After every fight I'll put "%s" on you.

Al seguir, Alfa se recarga para cambiar.en: When you continue, Alfa reloads to change the language and this setup picks up where you left it.

Al subir de nivel (y al entrar, si te qu.en: When you level up (and when you log in with points left), a notice says which talent to take, with a button to apply it.

Al subir de nivel te muestra qué aprende.en: When you level up, shows what to learn and what it costs.

Al subir de nivel, Alfa espera a la anim.en: When you level up, Alfa waits for the game's animation and gives you one summary.

Al subir de nivel, un aviso dice qué apr.en: When you level up, a notice says what to learn, what it costs and which trainer, with a Take me there button.

Al sur de Cuna del Invierno, una gargant.en: South of Winterspring, a hidden gorge is full of demons.

Al sur de Los Baldíos, el Gran Elevador.en: In the south of the Barrens, the Great Lift goes down to Thousand Needles. Don't look down!

Al sur está Dalaran, la ciudad de los ma.en: To the south lies Dalaran, the city of mages. Archimonde razed it in the Third War, and its mages are rebuilding it under a protective dome.

Al sur se alza una muralla enorme: el re.en: To the south rises a huge wall: King Genn Greymane built it to cut Gilneas off from the rest of the world.

Al terminar una guía de nivel, carga la.en: When a levelling guide ends, loads the next one without asking.

Al terminar una guía, la que sigue para.en: When you finish a guide, the next one for your level one click away.

Al terminar una pelea, Alfa te deja una.en: When a fight ends, Alfa leaves you a small card with how long it lasted, your damage and healing per second and what hit you hardest. It uses the game's official meter and only counts your own.

Al terminar una pelea, aquí queda su res.en: When a fight ends, its summary stays here: your damage, your healing and what hit you hardest.

Al terminar: cuánto duró, tu daño y tu c.en: When it ends: how long it lasted, your damage and healing per second and what hit you hardest.

Al terminarla, te propongo la siguiente.en: When you finish it, I suggest the next one for your level. One click on "Continue with…" and we keep hunting.

Al tomar una misión te la resumo en dos.en: When you take a quest I sum it up in two lines, my way: what to do and a little tip. The full story is still in "Stories".

Al tomar una misión, Lya te la resume en.en: When you take a quest, Lya sums it up in two lines: what to do and a little tip of hers.

Al volver con una misión lista, se entre.en: When you come back with a finished quest, it's turned in by itself. If there are rewards to choose from, you choose.

Alamuerte forjó en secreto el Alma de De.en: Deathwing secretly forged the Demon Soul, a golden disc charged with the other Aspects' power, which they gave him without knowing what he wanted it for.

Alamuerte se hizo pasar por Lord Daval P.en: Deathwing posed as Lord Daval Prestor, a noble who nearly became king of Alterac. That family sure loves disguises!

Alexandros Mograine empuñaba la Cremator.en: Alexandros Mograine wielded the Ashbringer, and the Scourge feared him like no one else. His own son, Renault, betrayed him.

Alfa (el de siempre), Clásico WoW (marco.en: Alfa (the one you know), Classic WoW (the game's frames and fonts), Glass (see-through), La Jauría Night (night blue and moon silver) or Campfire (charcoal and embers). Compact mode and your colours work in all of them.

Alfa arma una con lo que puedes juntar e.en: Alfa builds one from what you can gather in your zone, and the arrow takes you from spot to spot.

Alfa elige las misiones que más XP dan c.en: Alfa picks the quests near you that give the most XP, in three batches.

Alfa elige por ti: entregar las que tien.en: Alfa picks for you: turn in the ones you have ready, finish the ones in this zone or pick up new quests.

Alfa lo creó toxic3000 para sus amigos y.en: toxic3000 made Alfa for his friends and wanted to share it with everyone. It doesn't play for you: it helps you understand and enjoy the game at your own pace.

Alfa lo hace toxic3000 para La Jauría. E.en: Alfa is made by toxic3000 for La Jauría. It is free software (GPL-3.0) and its source is at github.com/toxic3000/alfa-forever.

Alfa lo pregunta al entrar sin escribir.en: Alfa asks when you log in without writing in your chat.

Alfa los cambia por el rango nuevo sin m.en: Alfa swaps them for the new rank without moving them.

Alfa mantiene %d ajustes que elegiste. A.en: Alfa keeps %d settings you chose. Open the window to see or change each one.

Alfa mantiene %d ajustes tuyos y los vue.en: Alfa keeps %d of your settings and reapplies them at login.

Alfa mide los caminos (vuelos y piedra d.en: Alfa measures the ways (flights and Hearthstone): it takes a few seconds.

Alfa no está afiliado a esos proyectos n.en: Alfa is not affiliated with or endorsed by those projects; thanks to all of them for sharing their work.

Alfa goes through its item database, keeps what your class can use near your level and compares it with what you wear, using your build's weights.

Alfa se encarga de lo repetitivo (acepta.en: Alfa handles the repetitive stuff (accepting, turning in, selling, repairing) and asks you at every fork in the road.

Alfa se está uniendo al canal oculto de.en: Alfa is joining La Jauría's hidden channel. In a few seconds you'll see who is sharing.

Alfa se muestra en el idioma que elijas,.en: Alfa shows in the language you pick, even if your game is in another one.

Alfa se recarga para cambiar el idioma..en: Alfa is reloading to change the language. The setup picks up where you left it.

Alfa solo leyó tus valores: nada cambia.en: Alfa only read your values: nothing changes until you touch a control.

Alfa solo te sugiere: el precio lo pones.en: Alfa only suggests: you set the price.

Alfa te avisa aquí de lo importante: equ.en: Alfa tells you what matters here: gear to repair, full bags, new skills, your class buff and your rest.

Alfa warns you about worn gear, full bags, what you can train, your buff and your rest. Choose which and when here.

Alfa te lleva paso a paso, con la flecha.en: Alfa takes you step by step, with the arrow and the route on the map. Choose the one for your zone and your level.

Alfa tiene muchas páginas, ¿se puede más.en: Alfa has lots of pages, can it be simpler?

Antes de buscar la espada, Arthas mandó.en: Before seeking the sword, Arthas had his own ships burned so his soldiers couldn't go home.

Antes de comprar algo en la subasta, rev.en: Before buying something at auction, check whether a vendor sells it cheaper.

Antes de empezar, unas palabras de la ma.en: Before we start, a few words from the pack.

Conozco la clase y el nivel de %d lobos.en: I know the class and level of %d online wolves. If you loot something they can use, I'll tell you.

Consejo: prueba con una palabra más cort.en: Tip: try a shorter word, or the one you'd use in the game ("bags", "arrow", "talents").

Conserva %s: vale más de otra forma..en: Keep %s: it's worth more another way.

Consigue bolsas más grandes en cuanto pu.en: Get bigger bags as soon as you can: more space, more loot.

Contar tu avance en el chat del grupo.en: Tell your progress in party chat

Contra jefes de nivel alto fallas mucho:.en: Against high-level bosses you miss a lot: this fixes it.

Contra jefes fallas mucho: esto te ayuda.en: Against bosses you miss a lot: this helps.

Contra lo que llevas: lo mismo..en: Against what you wear: the same.

Contra no-muertos y demonios: Exorcismo.en: Against undead and demons: Exorcism hits very hard.

Convierte a un enemigo en oveja un rato..en: Turns an enemy into a sheep for a while. The best control in dungeons.

Copia este texto (Ctrl+C) y pásalo a tu.en: Copy this text (Ctrl+C) and pass it to your pack. They paste it in Import.

Copia la cadena de abajo y pásala por el.en: Copy the string below and pass it on in chat or Discord: with Alfa they paste it in Import and get your same build.
Copy the string below and pass it on in chat or Discord: with Alfa they paste it in Import and get your same build.

Copiar mis atajos de Blizzard al mapa de.en: Copy my Blizzard shortcuts to Alfa's map

Corre hacia el enemigo y lo aturde un mo.en: Rush at the enemy and stun it for a moment. Use it to start the fight, from range.

Corres mucho más rápido un momento. Para.en: You run much faster for a moment. To flee or to catch someone.

Corres más rápido, pero si te pegan te a.en: You run faster, but getting hit dazes you. Only for traveling.

Cortar hechizos, amenaza, el tablón de l.en: Interrupts, threat, the pack board, mentoring and two new styles.

Costa Oscura está llena de ruinas élfica.en: Darkshore is full of elven ruins, such as Ameth'Aran, from a far older age.

Costasur y Molino Tarren están a un paso.en: Southshore and Tarren Mill are a stone's throw apart, and the Alliance and the Horde have always glared at each other here.

Costuras, una abominación enorme, ataca.en: Stitches, a huge abomination, attacks Darkshire in one of the forest's most famous quests.

Criaturas raras y tesoros: dónde aparece.en: Rare creatures and treasures: where they appear and what they drop.

Críticos enormes: matas antes de que te.en: Huge crits: you kill before they can heal.

Ctrl+clic: la flecha te lleva ahí..en: Ctrl+click: the arrow takes you there.

Cuadros por segundo y la latencia con el.en: Frames per second and your latency to the world. Click: Scenery and graphics, to run smoother.

Cualquier habilidad tuya que el juego re.en: Any of your abilities the game highlights because of an effect.

Cualquier instructor de pesca te la ense.en: Any fishing trainer teaches it. Then buy a pole and some nightcrawlers: that's all you need to start.

Cuando Lya olfatea un raro. En plena pel.en: When Lya sniffs out a rare. Mid-fight, a small icon and the announcement afterwards.

Cuando al monstruo le quede poca vida, u.en: When the monster is low on health, use Execute (Alfa warns you).

Cuando alguien de tu grupo sube de nivel.en: When someone in your group levels up, Lya howls, congratulates them and lets you congratulate them in chat with one click.

Cuando alguien lanza la cuenta del juego.en: When someone starts the game's countdown, an announcement with who started it and how long is left.

Cuando alguien pregunta «¿Listos?»: tu c.en: When someone asks «Ready?»: your food, ammo, gear and bag space, and who is missing a buff, with a button to give yours. Also with /alfa curacion listos.

Cuando aprendas %s, te avisa al momento.en: Once you learn %s, it alerts you right when to use them.

Cuando aprendas a cortar, aquí sale tu h.en: Once you learn an interrupt, your ability and its key show here.

Cuando aprendas una habilidad para corta.en: Once you learn an ability that interrupts spells, it alerts you as soon as your target starts casting.

Cuando aprendes un hechizo importante de.en: When you learn an important class spell, Lya tells you what it's for and when to use it.

Cuando aprendes un rango nuevo, un aviso.en: When you learn a new rank, a notice offers to swap it on your bars.

Cuando buscas algo en la subasta, Alfa g.en: When you search the auction house, Alfa keeps the lowest price you see.

Cuando el Pozo de la Eternidad explotó,.en: When the Well of Eternity exploded, the great ancient continent broke apart. They call it the Great Sundering.

Cuando el alfa de La Jauría anda cerca..en: When La Jauría's alpha is nearby.

Cuando el juego termina de cargar, Alfa.en: When the game finishes loading, Alfa checks what you chose here and puts it back if something changed it. If you later change them in the game menu, Alfa keeps the new ones.

Cuando el tranvía subterráneo está por l.en: When the underground tram is about to arrive.

Cuando entras a una posada o ciudad, y c.en: When you enter an inn or a town, and when your rested XP runs out.

Cuando hay un festival, vale la pena dar.en: When there's a festival it's worth a visit: it almost always brings pets, clothes or food you can't get the rest of the year.

Cuando hay varias para elegir, toma la q.en: When there are several to choose from, takes the one that helps you most.

Cuando huelo salchichas se me olvida tod.en: When I smell sausages I forget everything. Well, except you.

Cuando la Legión volvió en la Tercera Gu.en: When the Legion returned in the Third War, Malfurion and Tyrande sounded the Horn of Cenarius to wake the sleeping druids.

Cuando la meta de ahora de tu plan es un.en: When your plan's current goal is a place, the arrow takes it without a click.

Cuando le baja la vida aturde a todos y.en: As his health drops he stuns everyone and runs to his chest to switch weapons: wait, don't chase him.

Cuando levantes algo que le sirve a un l.en: When you loot something an online wolf can use, I'll tell you here. They share their class and level in the settings.

Cuando llegas a donde apunta la flecha,.en: When you reach where the arrow points, Lya gives a happy hop. No words, no sound.

Cuando lleves algo, Alfa te dice si conv.en: When you carry something, Alfa tells you whether to vendor, auction or craft it, and how much you earn.

Cuando los orcos se volvieron brujos, de.en: When the orcs turned to warlocks, they stopped hearing the elements. Thrall gave them that path back.

Cuando no sepas algo de Alfa, dame clic.en: Whenever you don't know something about Alfa, right-click me and choose "How can I help?": I explain each thing and take you to it. I also tell you stories about where you are.

Cuando otro lobo con Alfa comparta su ub.en: When another wolf with Alfa shares their location, they show here and on your map. To grow the pack, invite your friends: they install Alfa, agree to share and join La Jauría's Discord.

Cuando sales como espíritu te digo a cuá.en: When you release as a ghost I tell you how far your corpse is, what the Spirit Healer costs at your level and what's best. The arrow takes you there.

Cuando se abre una misión de clase para.en: When a class quest opens up for you, offers its guide.

Cuando se acaba tu cebo y no te queda ot.en: When your lure runs out and you have no other, or when you reach the cap of your Fishing rank.

Cuando se te acaban te digo qué te convi.en: When you run low I tell you what suits your level and take you to the nearest vendor. Water only if you use mana.

Cuando te llega equipo mejor que lo que.en: When you get gear that's better than what you're wearing, a notice with a button to put it on (only with your click and out of combat).

Cuando te quedes sin maná, cambia a form.en: When you run out of mana, switch to Cat Form to finish the fight.

Cuando tengas pescado que sepas cocinar,.en: When you have fish you know how to cook, it shows up here.

Cuando tu barco está por llegar al muell.en: When your boat is about to reach the dock.

Cuando tu guía dice «Sube al nivel», el.en: When your guide says "Reach level", the tracker tells you how much experience you need and where it pays most: enemies of your level that also count for your quests. "Take me" and the arrow takes you.

Cuando tu objetivo lance algo que se pue.en: When your target casts something you can interrupt, it alerts you with %s and its key.

Cuando tu objetivo lanza algo que se pue.en: When your target casts something you can interrupt: your interrupt, its key and whether it's ready.

Cuando tu objetivo o tu foco empieza a l.en: When your target or focus starts casting something you can interrupt, Alfa alerts you with your interrupt, its key and whether it's ready. In dungeons the game sometimes hides it: there it still tells you something is being cast.

Cuando tu paso lo pide y hablas con su p.en: When your step asks for it and you talk to its innkeeper. Never at another inn.

Cuando tu zepelín está por llegar..en: When your zeppelin is about to arrive.

Cuando tus bolsas se llenan, Hoy te dice.en: When your bags fill up, Today tells you what you can sell and how much you'll get.

Cuando tú o tu grupo peleen, aquí sale q.en: When you or your group fight, you'll see here who deals the most damage.

Cuando un elfo de la noche muere, su esp.en: When a night elf dies, their spirit takes the form of a wisp and runs faster back to their body.

Cuando un lobo de la manada encuentra un.en: When a pack wolf finds a rare, I tell you which den it's in and let you ask to enter with one click.

Cuando un lobo de tu zona pide ayuda, te.en: When a wolf in your zone asks for help, you're told where they are with "On my way!": the arrow takes you and tells them you're coming.

Cuando un lobo encuentra un raro o un te.en: When a wolf finds a rare or a treasure in your zone, it tells you which den it's in. If it's yours, "Go hunt"; if it's another, "Ask to enter".

Cuando un oficio llega al tope de su ran.en: When a profession reaches its rank cap, Lya tells you that you can learn the next one and where your trainer is.

Cuando una pieza baja de este porcentaje.en: When a piece drops below this percentage.

Cuando una zona se llena, el juego la pa.en: When a zone fills up, the game splits it into dens (layers): the same place with other people, other rares and other ore. Ask to enter a pack member's den and the game moves you there when you join their group.

Cuando usas una habilidad que tarda 30 s.en: When you use an ability that takes 30 seconds or more to come back, Alfa puts it in a discreet bar with the time left. In Combat you choose which ones you don't want to see.

Cuando vas solo por el mundo, así no sal.en: When you're out in the world on your own, so it doesn't pop up after every enemy.

Cuando venzas a tu primer jefe, tu progr.en: Once you defeat your first boss, your progress shows up here.

Cuando ves a alguien que también usa Alf.en: When you see someone who also uses Alfa (and shares with the pack), a short announcement tells you so you can say hi.

Cuando ves caer a un raro, me acuerdo: e.en: When you see a rare die, I remember: in its tooltip and in La Jauría I tell you how long ago it was killed and whether it may be back (after about half an hour).

Cuando ya casi se rompe..en: When it is about to break.

Cuando ya entregaste todo o cerraste tu.en: When you've turned everything in or finished your zone, it tells you what's next (you set the arrow with "Take me").

Cuerpo a cuerpo con tótems y golpes elem.en: Melee with totems and elemental strikes: the shaman that levels best.

Cuestan %s: te alcanza..en: They cost %s: you can afford it.

Cuida bien a %s, que la manada lo necesi.en: Take good care of %s, the pack needs them.

Cuidado al nadar mar adentro: en aguas p.en: Careful swimming out to sea: in deep water you get fatigued and can drown.

Cuidado con atraer varios a la vez: Fueg.en: Careful pulling several at once: Fire doesn't have as much control.

Cumpliste todas sus metas. Elige otro pl.en: You met all its goals. Pick another plan or build a new one.

Cura a quien tenga el dolor de sombras;.en: Heal whoever has the shadow pain; the fight is short.

Cura a sus ayudantes y a sí misma: inter.en: She heals her helpers and herself: interrupt her.

Cura a todo tu grupo a la vez. Perfecta.en: Heals your whole group at once. Perfect when everyone is getting hit.

Cura a tu grupo con un clic..en: Heal your group with one click.

Cura a tu mascota poco a poco. Mantenla.en: Heals your pet over time. Keep it alive: it looks after you.

Cura con un clic y ese compañero queda s.en: Heal with a click and that teammate stays targeted; cleanse curses and poisons with another click.

Cura de golpe y luego un rato más..en: Heals at once and then some more over time.

Cura poco a poco. Ideal para alguien que.en: Heals over time. Great for someone taking steady damage.

Cura poco a poco. Ponla en quien recibe.en: Heals over time. Put it on whoever is taking damage.

Cuándo vuelve sola detrás de tu personaj.en: When it swings back behind your character on its own.

Cuánta lluvia, nieve y polvo se ve cuand.en: How much rain, snow and dust you see in bad weather.

Cuánta memoria usa cada parte de Alfa ah.en: How much memory each part of Alfa uses right now, and frees what it no longer needs. Also with /alfa rendimiento.

Cuántas capas de sombra se dibujan: con.en: How many shadow layers are drawn: with more layers, sharp shadows reach farther.

Cuántas casillas caben en cada fila..en: How many slots fit in each row.

Cuántas casillas libres quedan cuando Al.en: How many free slots are left when Alfa warns you.

Cuánto daño quita cada bloqueo; también.en: How much damage each block removes; it also raises Shield Slam's damage.

Cuánto dura un aviso en pantalla.en: How long an alert stays on screen

Cuánto esperar con el ratón quieto antes.en: How long to wait with the mouse still before showing it. With Shift you see it right away, compared with your gear; right-click to compare and more.

Cuánto falta para tu siguiente golpe aut.en: How long until your next auto attack, for each hand. Helps you fit Slam or Heroic Strike in without losing swings.

Cuánto más brillan las luces que en una.en: How much brighter lights get than on a normal screen. The game never goes past your monitor's maximum.

Cuánto pasto, flores y hierbas cubren el.en: How much grass, flowers and weeds cover the ground.

Cuánto por debajo de lo que vale tiene q.en: How far below its worth your price has to be to warn you.

Cuánto se ve el fondo de las ventanas de.en: How visible the chat windows' background is; at zero only the border remains.

Cuánto te falta para el 60 a tu ritmo, q.en: How far you are from 60 at your pace, which guides and dungeons are yours and how much you move up each day.

Cuántos tienes, en el cuadro de cada obj.en: How many you have, in each item's tooltip

Cuántos van en cada columna (o fila) ant.en: How many go in each column (or row) before starting another. 5 is one party per column.

Cuéntame algo de aquí.en: Tell me something about this place

Cuéntanos qué te parece en La Jauría..en: Tell us what you think in La Jauría.

Cámbialo en el menú del juego: Opciones.en: Change it in the game menu: Options > %s > “%s”. Alfa doesn't change it for you: the game reads it in combat and would break.

Cólera de las bestias: tu mascota pega m.en: Bestial Wrath: your pet hits much harder for a while.

Cómo conseguir cualquier objeto, misión.en: How to get any item, quest or NPC, and which guide takes you there.

Cómo conseguir cualquier objeto, montura.en: How to get any item, mount, NPC, quest or place.

Cópialo con Ctrl+C y guárdalo, o pásasel.en: Copy it with Ctrl+C and keep it, or pass it to the pack. To bring it back: "Import".

Cópialo con Ctrl+C. Luego abre «Hermanda.en: Copy it with Ctrl+C. Then open "Guild & Communities", pick %s, press "Invite Member" and paste it with Ctrl+V.

Cópialos con Ctrl+C y pégalos en tu repo.en: Copy them with Ctrl+C and paste them into your report. "Report" already includes them.

Dale de comer a tu mascota para que esté.en: Feed your pet so it's happy and hits harder.

Dale de comer para que esté feliz: pega.en: Feed it to keep it happy: it hits harder.

Dame clic derecho y elige «¿En qué te ay.en: Right-click me and choose "How can I help?" whenever you like. Good hunting, wolf!

Darnassus está en las ramas de Teldrassi.en: Darnassus sits in the branches of Teldrassil. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rules from the Temple of the Moon.

Dath'Remar Caminante del Sol guió a los.en: Dath'Remar Sunstrider led the high elves to Quel'Thalas. Prince Kael'thas comes from his line.

Datos curiosos de Lya, escritos por Alfa.en: Lya's fun facts, written by Alfa.

Daño a todos los que están cerca de ti..en: Damages everyone close to you. For when you're surrounded.

Daño arcano al instante y un rato más. B.en: Instant arcane damage plus more over time. Good to open or on the move.

Daño con el tiempo: ponla al empezar la.en: Damage over time: apply it as the fight starts.

Daño de arcos, armas de fuego y ballesta.en: Damage for bows, guns and crossbows.

Daño de escarcha que deja lento al enemi.en: Frost damage that slows the enemy. Perfect if it runs.
Frost damage that slows the enemy. Your spell for keeping it away.

Daño de fuego al instante. Úsalo para re.en: Instant fire damage. Use it to finish off or on the move.

Daño de fuego que quema un rato. Bueno p.en: Fire damage that keeps burning. Good to open a fight.

Daño de sombra durante un buen rato. Pon.en: Shadow damage over a good while. Put it on first.

Daño de sombra durante un rato. Ponla al.en: Shadow damage over time. Put it on first and move on to something else.

Daño de sombra fuerte. Buen golpe para e.en: Strong shadow damage. A good opener or finisher.

Daño de sombra que hace lento al enemigo.en: Shadow damage that slows the enemy. Channel it while it comes at you.

Daño directo de fuego y sombras: matas a.en: Direct fire and shadow damage: you kill before the monster arrives.

Daño directo de tus armas y habilidades..en: Direct damage for your weapons and abilities.

Daño en grupo de cinco: pegar fuerte sin.en: Damage in a five-player group: hit hard without stealing monsters from the tank.

Daño extra después de recibir un golpe c.en: Extra damage after taking a critical strike.

Daño rápido que también interrumpe hechi.en: Quick damage that also interrupts spells. Use it on casters.

Daño sagrado fuerte contra no-muertos y.en: Strong holy damage against undead and demons.

De 1 a 300, dónde pescar cerca de ti, eq.en: From 1 to 300, where to fish near you, gear, lures, quests and the tournament.

De 1 a 300: qué hacer, con qué y dónde a.en: From 1 to 300: what to do, with what and where to learn

De arriba abajo: la primera que el juego.en: Top to bottom: the first one the game lets you use is the one on the icon. What the game makes glow jumps to the front; area abilities show with several enemies fighting. Only the ones you've learned appear.
Top to bottom: the first one the game lets you use is the one on the icon; area ones only with 3 or more enemies fighting.

De donde estés a cualquier lugar, con vu.en: From wherever you are to any place, with flights, boats, zeppelins, portals and on foot, and the list of legs.

De este lugar Lya todavía no sabe datos.en: Lya doesn't know any fun facts about this place yet. Pick a quest from the list to read its story.

De este lugar todavía no sé mucho. ¿Vemo.en: I don't know much about this place yet. Shall we look at your stories?

De fábrica el seguimiento muestra solo l.en: By default the tracker shows only what you're doing; on, it shows the whole step with its notes.

De nivel %.1f a %.1f, con unos %s de oro.en: From level %.1f to %.1f, with about %s in gold. Only quests you can already take; what needs more level comes after a step that waits for it.

De noche Durotar refresca y se ven mucha.en: At night Durotar cools down and you can see lots of stars from Orgrimmar.

De noche Teldrassil se llena de luciérna.en: At night Teldrassil fills with fireflies. It's the night elves' hour.

De noche Un'Goro ruge. Los diablosaurios.en: At night Un'Goro roars. The crater's devilsaurs never sleep.

De noche Vallefresno brilla con luz de l.en: At night Ashenvale glows in the moonlight. The furbolgs are asleep... almost all of them.

De noche en Cuna del Invierno la aurora.en: At night in Winterspring the aurora paints the sky. It's worth watching for a bit.

De noche en Dun Morogh la nieve cruje ba.en: At night in Dun Morogh the snow crunches under my paws. I love that sound.

De noche en Elwynn se oyen los lobos del.en: At night in Elwynn you hear the forest wolves. Don't worry: they're distant cousins.

De noche en Los Humedales croan las rana.en: At night in the Wetlands the frogs croak and raptors lurk in the reeds.

De noche en Mulgore el viento canta entr.en: At night in Mulgore the wind sings between the mesas. The tauren say it's the Earth Mother.

De noche en Tanaris la arena se enfría r.en: At night in Tanaris the sand cools quickly. Watch out for scorpions.

De noche en el Bosque del Ocaso los worg.en: At night in Duskwood the worgen come out to hunt. Stay close to me.

De noche en las Tierras de la Peste los.en: At night in the Plaguelands the dead walk more. Stay near the light.

De noche los Defias se mueven por los Pá.en: At night the Defias move across Westfall. Look carefully before entering a farm.

De todo %s, ¿qué rincón te gusta más?.en: Out of all of %s, which corner do you like best?

De tu gente todavía no sé mucho. ¿Te cue.en: I don't know much about your people yet. Shall I tell you something else?

De tu nivel al 60, a tu ritmo.en: From your level to 60, at your pace

De tus bolsas le sirve:.en: From your bags, useful for them:

De vez en cuando Lya te pide una. Te las.en: Every now and then Lya asks you for one. She keeps careful count.

Debajo del ícono: útil mientras aprendes.en: Under the icon: handy while you learn.

Deja %s abajo y pasa el ratón por cualqu.en: Hold %s down and hover over anything in Alfa: I'll tell you what it's for.

Deja Alt abajo y pasa el ratón por cualq.en: Hold Alt and hover anything in Alfa: I'll tell you what it does. You can change the key in Style and sound.

Deja esta tecla abajo y pasa el ratón po.en: Hold this key and hover anything in Alfa: I'll tell you what it does.

Deja que el tanque golpee primero unos s.en: Let the tank hit first for a few seconds before you use your big strikes.

Deja que la manada te vea en el mapa.en: Let the pack see you on the map

Deja que tu mascota empiece la pelea y d.en: Let your pet start the fight and shoot when the monster is attacking it.

Deja solo lo esencial: tú, tu grupo, tus.en: Leaves only the essentials: you, your group, your markers and the guide's next step.

Deja una nota en tu mapa donde estás (/a.en: Leave a note on your map where you stand (/alfa nota <text>)

Dejaste la vuelta: la flecha vuelve a tu.en: You left the run: the arrow goes back to your guide.

Dejaste una nota en tu mapa: «%s»..en: You left a note on your map: "%s".

Dejé %d cartas que se abren a mano (pago.en: I left %d letters you open by hand (cash on delivery or from a GM).

Dejé 1 carta que se abre a mano (pago co.en: I left 1 letter you open by hand (cash on delivery or from a GM).

Del buzón: %s (no cuenta por hora).en: From the mailbox: %s (not counted per hour)

Del motor de Alfa: al subir de nivel te.en: From Alfa's engine: on level up it shows what to learn and what it costs.

Del motor de Alfa: con el entrenador más.en: From Alfa's engine: with the nearest trainer on your way.

Dentro de mazmorras y ciudades no hay no.en: Dungeons and cities have no nodes. Head out into the world and your route is one click away.

Dentro de una instancia el juego no deja.en: Inside an instance the game does not allow sharing: it goes out on its own when you leave.

Dentro de una instancia no hay planos..en: There are no layers inside an instance.

Dentro de una instancia no se puede segu.en: You can't follow anyone inside an instance.

Dentro de una mazmorra, al apuntar a un.en: Inside a dungeon, targeting a boss shows a small card with what to do for your role and how your quests there are going. It never catches clicks.

Dentro de una mazmorra, apunta al jefe:.en: Inside a dungeon, target the boss: a card at the top shows what to do for your role and how your quests there are going.

Derrotar al último jefe de todas las maz.en: Defeating the final boss of every dungeon in a level range gives one Legacy point per range.

Desapareces y vuelves al sigilo, aun en.en: You vanish back into stealth, even in combat. Your emergency escape.

Desarmar más seguido: quitas el arma a l.en: Disarm more often: you take the weapon from enemies who hit hard.

Descansa en una posada o una ciudad para.en: Rest at an inn or in a town to build more.

Descansado: doble experiencia por cazar.en: Rested: double experience from hunting up to %d %% of level %d

Descansas aquí: tu experiencia de descan.en: You rest here: your rested experience fills up.

Descubrir aquí te dio %d de experiencia.en: Discovering here gave you %d experience last time.

Desde %d puedes aprender %s con un instr.en: From %d you can learn %s from a trainer.

Desde Auberdine sale un barco al muelle.en: A ship leaves Auberdine for the Rut'theran dock, at the foot of Teldrassil.

Desde el nivel 20, desuellas bestias de.en: From level 20, you skin beasts up to your skill divided by 5. You need a skinning knife.

Desde el sigilo y por la espalda: lo hac.en: From stealth and from behind: makes it bleed for a good while.

Desde el sigilo y por la espalda: un gol.en: From stealth and from behind: a huge opening hit.

Desde el sigilo: aturde al enemigo unos.en: From stealth: stuns the enemy for a few seconds so you start ahead.

Desde hoy apunto cada paso grande que de.en: From today on, I'll write down every big step we take together.

Desde tu última visita también hubo camb.en: Since your last visit there were also changes in %s: find them in "See everything new".

Desencanta los objetos verdes y azules q.en: Disenchant the green and blue items you don't use to get dusts, essences and shards.

Desgarrar hace más daño mientras el mons.en: Rend does more damage while the monster bleeds; you need it for Deep Wounds.

El lago Lordamere separa el Bosque de Ar.en: Lordamere Lake separates Silverpine Forest from the Hillsbrad Foothills and the Alterac Mountains.

El lago de Loch Modan existe gracias a u.en: Loch Modan's lake exists thanks to a huge dwarven dam. If it broke, the water would sweep away the lands below.

El lago del Claro de la Luna se llama El.en: Moonglade's lake is called Elune'ara, in honor of the moon goddess.

El lago helado de Kel'Theril guarda ruin.en: The frozen lake of Kel'Theril holds Highborne ruins.

El lobo de la intro aúlla de pie sobre l.en: The intro wolf howls standing on the rock, a long howl another wolf answers; and when you log in, Lya comes running to tell you she missed you.

El lobo te recibe al entrar.en: The wolf greets you when you log in

El lobo te recibe cada vez que entras al.en: The wolf greets you every time you log in, redrawn: a real wolf's head, ears and muzzle.

El maestro de vuelo, la posada, reparar,.en: The flight master, the inn, repairs, the bank and more, with the arrow.
The flight master, the inn, repairs, the bank and more: the nearest one, with the arrow and the route.
The flight master, the inn, repairs, the bank... the nearest one (/alfa cerca ayuda).

El mago Rhonin y el dragón Korialstrasz.en: The mage Rhonin and the dragon Korialstrasz helped free Alexstrasza at Grim Batol, and the Demon Soul was destroyed there.

El mago que más daño hace: hechizos de f.en: The mage that does the most damage: fire spells and crits that burn.

El mapa abre sin errores con M y se arra.en: The map opens with M without errors and drags smoothly, even when you start over an icon.

El mapa de Alfa muestra el terreno real,.en: Alfa's map shows the real terrain, with flight points, dungeons, boats, zeppelins and portals.

El mapa de Alfa, el del juego y el minim.en: Alfa's map, the game's and the minimap. If something is in the way, turn it off here; Alfa's other modules add their layers to this same list.

El mapa de Alfa, en el lugar de tu flech.en: Alfa's map, right where your arrow points

El mapa de Alfa: el mundo entero, tus ma.en: Alfa's map: the whole world, your markers and layers

El mapa no se abre en combate..en: The map doesn't open in combat.

El mapa se ve más limpio: sin líneas fin.en: The map looks cleaner: no thin lines between its pieces and no dark halos on the edges of zones.

El marco de las barras de experiencia y.en: The frame of the experience and reputation bars; the fill keeps its colours.

El marco del menú del juego y de las bol.en: The frame of the game menu and the bags, at the bottom right.

El marco del tanque late en rojo cuando.en: The tank's frame pulses red below 40% health.

El mariscal Dughan cuida Villadorada y s.en: Marshal Dughan watches over Goldshire and is always looking for someone to help with Elwynn's troubles.

El medallón bajo cada marca del mapa y d.en: The medallion under every mark on the map and minimap: Alfa's, or the glyph alone with no medallion.

El medidor de daño aguanta en combate y.en: The damage meter holds up in combat, and the rotation helper no longer asks you to interrupt what can't be interrupted.

El medidor de daño sale solo en grupo, c.en: The damage meter shows up by itself in a group, compact and without covering your bars.

El medidor del juego no tiene números de.en: The game's meter has no numbers for this fight.

El medidor vuelve en tu próximo grupo. P.en: The meter comes back in your next group. To turn it off completely, go to Combat settings.

El mekigeniero Termochufe, el traidor de.en: Mekgineer Thermaplugg, the traitor of Gnomeregan, is still hiding inside the city: he's its final boss.

El menú de la lupa del mapa del juego ti.en: The game map's magnifying glass menu also lists every Alfa layer.

El mineral se funde en barras en cualqui.en: Ore is smelted into bars at any forge.

El minimapa de Recolección descansa cuan.en: Gathering's minimap rests when it has nothing to show.

El minimapa pasa de redondo a cuadrado,.en: The minimap goes from round to square, with a thin border. Not recommended with a rotating minimap.

El mismo arreglo llegó a los asistentes.en: The same fix reached the Route and Healing assistants.

El mitril abunda en las Tierras Inhóspit.en: Mithril is plentiful in the Badlands, the Hinterlands and Tanaris.

El modo pesca se abre al salir de combat.en: Fishing mode opens when you leave combat.

El modo prueba se usa fuera de combate..en: Test mode works out of combat.

El motor no aceptó la guía..en: The engine did not accept the guide.

El motor no puede armar guías ahora..en: The engine can't build guides right now.

El mundo entero en un mapa.en: The whole world on one map

El mundo pierde el color mientras eres e.en: The world loses its color while you're a ghost.

El más cercano cuando le toque, por tiem.en: The nearest when its turn comes, by travel time.

El módulo Curación no está cargado..en: The Healing module is not loaded.

El nombre de cada zona sobre el mapa de.en: Each zone's name on Alfa's map.

El número abajo a la izquierda de cada p.en: The number at the bottom left of each piece of gear.

El número es el orden en que se toma. Pa.en: The number is the order it is taken in. Hover a talent to see what it does.

El número que cuenta hacia atrás. Apagad.en: The countdown number. Off, just the bar.

El objeto que usa el paso actual, o el o.en: The item the current step uses, or a quest item it collects, glows in your bags. An item a later step needs gets a lock, so you don't sell it.

El orden importa más que los números: bu.en: The order matters more than the numbers: look for pieces with the first ones on the list.

El paisaje lejano deja de perderse en la.en: The far landscape no longer fades into thick fog.
The far landscape no longer fades into thick fog. Sometimes you can see where the loaded area ends.

El paquete de datos de Alfa (Alfa_Codex).en: Alfa's data pack (Alfa_Codex) is disabled: enable it in the AddOns list and reload.

El paso de ahora de tu guía te lleva a e.en: Your guide's current step takes you to train.

El pequeño rey Anduin Wrynn lleva su nom.en: The young king Anduin Wrynn was named in honor of Anduin Lothar, the hero who saved his people.

El primer clic abre la Cocina del juego;.en: The first click opens the game's Cooking window; the next one cooks the batch. You need to be next to a fire.

El primer jefe de guerra de la Horda fue.en: The Horde's first warchief was Blackhand. His son Rend Blackhand now serves Nefarian in Blackrock Spire.

El primer punto del Legado suele llegar.en: Your first Legacy point usually comes at level 25, and it unlocks the Legacy.

El pícaro más fácil para subir: pega de.en: The easiest rogue to level: it hits from the front, dodges a lot and holds up better than the others.

El rango Experto viene en un libro de De.en: The Expert rank comes in a book from Deneb Walker (Arathi Highlands) or Balai Lok'Wein (Dustwallow Marsh); Artisan, with the quest "Triage" in Theramore or Hammerfall.

El rango Experto viene en un libro que v.en: The Expert rank comes in a book sold by the Booty Bay fisherman, in Stranglethorn.
The Expert rank comes in a book sold by cooking suppliers; Artisan, with a quest from Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.

El rango de niveles de cada zona, con co.en: Each zone's level range, coloured for your level.

El rastreador te avisa si tu plan se que.en: The tracker tells you if your plan ran out of steps and rebuilds it with one click.

El rastreador te dice el siguiente paso.en: The tracker tells you the next step and the arrow takes you there.

El registro de daño del juego está apaga.en: The game's damage tracking is off
The game's damage tracking is off: turn it on to see your group's top.

El reino humano de Alterac traicionó a l.en: The human kingdom of Alterac betrayed the Alliance in the Second War: its king, Aiden Perenolde, sided with the Horde. That's why the kingdom fell.

El reino limita los mensajes de addon sa.en: The realm limits outgoing addon messages: %s

El reloj de Alfa mueve %d tareas. La que.en: Alfa's clock runs %d tasks. The slowest: %s (%.1f ms over %d runs).

El resumen se ve al salir de combate..en: The summary shows once you leave combat.

El rey Llane Wrynn murió en la Primera G.en: King Llane Wrynn died in the First War at the hands of Garona, the Horde's spy.

El rey Magni Barbabronce gobierna Forjaz.en: King Magni Bronzebeard rules Ironforge; his brothers are Muradin and Brann, the explorer.

El rey Thoradin unió a las tribus humana.en: King Thoradin united the human tribes in Arathor, and the high elves taught them magic so they could defeat the Amani trolls together.

El rey Varian Wrynn es hijo de Llane, el.en: King Varian Wrynn is the son of Llane, the king who died in the First War.

El rey Varian desapareció camino a una r.en: King Varian vanished on his way to a peace summit. Meanwhile his young son Anduin reigns, with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon as regent.

El sanador de los chamanes: curas en cad.en: The shamans' healer: chain heals and totems that help the whole group.

El sanador de los druidas: curas a cualq.en: The druids' healer: you heal any group and survive well, though solo you kill slowly.

El sanador de los paladines: curas fuert.en: The paladins' healer: strong heals and lots of armor, ideal for groups.

El sanador puro: curas grandes y curas p.en: The pure healer: big heals and heals for the whole group.

El sistema de equipo de Alfa no está dis.en: Alfa's gear system is not available.

El sol aquí no perdona: las Tierras Inhó.en: The sun here is merciless: the Badlands are a land of coyotes, buzzards and basilisks.

El sol de Durotar quema la tierra roja..en: Durotar's sun scorches the red earth. No wonder the orcs are so tough.

El suelo y los muros se ven nítidos aunq.en: Ground and walls stay sharp even when far away or at an angle.

El tablón está apagado (Ajustes de La Ja.en: The board is off (La Jauría settings).

El tanque clásico: bloqueas mucho, gener.en: The classic tank: you block a lot, build threat with Revenge and Shield Slam, and have Last Stand for when everything goes wrong.

El tanque más difícil de matar: todos lo.en: The hardest tank to kill: every defense talent, Improved Shield Wall and early Last Stand. Perfect for starting to tank.

El texto llegó cortado o cambiado: cópia.en: The text arrived cut or changed: copy it again.

El tipo de nodos que une la ruta..en: The kind of nodes the route links.

El tono de los fondos: Grafito es el de.en: The tone of the backgrounds: Graphite is Alfa's own, Night the darkest and Slate a neutral grey.

El top de DPS de tu grupo o banda en una.en: Your group's or raid's DPS top in a small window, with the current and the previous fight.

El torio abunda en el Cráter de Un'Goro.en: Thorium is plentiful in Un'Goro Crater and Winterspring.

El velo de pantalla de algunas zonas y h.en: The screen veil of some zones and shadow spells.

El verdadero nombre de Thrall es Go'el,.en: Thrall's true name is Go'el, the one his parents gave him.

El viejo ermitaño Abercrombie parece ama.en: Old hermit Abercrombie seems kind... until you find out who he's trying to bring back.

El «zug zug» de los peones quiere decir.en: The peons' «zug zug» means something like «okay». Zug zug, boss!

El ángel te revive ya y a tu nivel no qu.en: The Spirit Healer brings you back now and at your level you won't be weakened, but your gear loses %d %% durability.

El ángel te revive ya, pero tu equipo pi.en: The Spirit Healer brings you back now, but your gear loses %d %% durability and you stay weakened for %s.

El árbol de ruta de Alfa, misiones que s.en: Alfa's route tree, quests as they unlock and an item catalogue.

El ícono grande es lo que conviene presi.en: The big icon is what's best to press now and the small ones, what comes next. If it pulses, the game lit that ability up; the dark sweep is its cooldown. You decide: Alfa never presses anything.

El último punto: paras un poco más..en: The last point: you parry a little more.

Elegida por ti en los ajustes..en: Chosen by you in the settings.

Elegir lo que pide tu paso.en: Pick what your step asks for

Elige a dónde ir: Alfa arma el camino co.en: Pick where to go: Alfa builds the way with flights, boats, zeppelins, portals and on foot.

Elige abajo qué cocinar y cuánto: la col.en: Choose below what to cook and how much: the queue waits for your click on each batch.

Elige el objeto en la Enciclopedia..en: Choose the item in the Encyclopedia.

Elige la opción que nombra tu guía, o ab.en: Picks the option your guide names, or opens the shop or training you need.

Elige para qué, escribe qué buscas y pul.en: Pick what for, write what you're after and press "Post": the wolves in your guild with Alfa see it. It goes away on its own after an hour.

Elige qué guardar: lo que ya tienes en e.en: Choose what to store: what you already have in the bank, materials, a category or everything that isn't gear. It all moves at once, out of combat.

Elige qué quieres hacer y Alfa te lleva.en: Choose what you want to do and Alfa takes you step by step.

Elige qué se ve en el mapa: guía, mision.en: Choose what the map shows: guide, quests, rares, travel, zones and what other modules add.

Elige sola la única opción de los PNJ si.en: Picks the only option of NPCs without quests.

Elige solo misiones que ya puedes tomar..en: It only picks quests you can already take.

Elige tu camino. Si no sabes, empieza po.en: Choose your path. If you are not sure, start with leveling up: Alfa tells you what pays off.

Elige tu tiempo otra vez y arma uno nuev.en: Pick your time again and make a new one whenever you like.

Elige tus clics, acomoda tus marcos y pr.en: Choose your clicks, place your frames and test them. It takes a minute.

Elige tus minutos con la barra de abajo..en: Pick your minutes with the slider below.

Elige un camino: Alfa arma tu plan y te.en: Pick a path: Alfa builds your plan and guides you step by step.

Elige un día y una hora que aún no pasen.en: Pick a day and time that hasn't passed yet (up to a week).

Elige una receta o un oficio y Alfa te d.en: Pick a recipe or a profession and Alfa tells you which materials you're missing and where each one comes from. Also from the Encyclopedia.

Elige una y listo: Alfa ajusta tus misio.en: Pick one and you're done: Alfa sets up your quests, your guide, vendors and travel. Hold Shift in game to decide yourself in the moment.

Elige uno y lo ves al instante en esta v.en: Pick one and see it at once in this window and every Alfa window, the arrow too.

Ella duerme a todo el grupo y luego resu.en: She puts the whole group to sleep and then revives Mograine: that's normal, don't panic.

Elune, la diosa de la luna, es la fe de.en: Elune, the moon goddess, is the faith of the night elves. Her priestesses are the Sisterhood of Elune, and Tyrande is their high priestess.

Elwynn de día es pura paz: el río, los c.en: Elwynn by day is pure peace: the river, the fields and the smell of bread from Goldshire.

Embate con escudo: mucho daño y amenaza..en: Shield Slam: lots of damage and threat.

Embate deja de reiniciar tu ataque: un g.en: Slam stops resetting your swing: an extra hit between swings.

Embate sin perder tu ataque automático..en: Slam without losing your auto attack.

Embate sin perder tu golpe automático..en: Slam without losing your auto attack.

Embate sin reiniciar tu ataque: un golpe.en: Slam without resetting your swing: an extra hit.

Embate: un golpe fuerte entre golpe y go.en: Slam: a strong hit between swings.

Empieza al usar este objeto.en: Starts when you use this item

Empieza con %s, que se consigue en la ma.en: It starts with %s, found in the dungeon.

Empieza con tu hechizo más lento desde l.en: Start with your slowest spell from afar and finish with the instant ones.

Empieza de cero, por ejemplo después de.en: Start from scratch, for example after sending your report.

Empiezas a juntar XP descansada.en: You're starting to build rested XP

En %d segundos, Alfa fue juntando %.1f K.en: In %d seconds, Alfa gathered %.1f KB of memory per second. What gathers the most:

En Ajustes > Estilo y sonido prende «Let.en: In Settings > Style and sound turn on "Bigger text" and, if red and green look alike to you, "Colour-blind friendly colours".

En Bolsas, «Buscar en todos tus personaj.en: In Bags, "Search all your characters" checks everyone's bags, banks and gear, with type, quality and character filters.

En Bolsas, «Qué guardar» te dice lo que.en: In Bags, "What to store" tells you what's more useful in the bank: materials for your other characters' recipes, what their quests ask for and gear your class doesn't use. With a banker, "To the bank" and done.

En Burning Crusade, Karazhan abre sus pu.en: In Burning Crusade, Karazhan opens its doors as a raid.

En Burning Crusade, el Vuelo Bronce pide.en: In Burning Crusade, the Bronze Flight asks for help in the Caverns of Time against dragons who want to change history.

En Burning Crusade, las Cavernas del Tie.en: In Burning Crusade, the Caverns of Time take you back to these foothills to witness Thrall's escape from Durnholde.

En Caer Darrow, junto al lago, todavía r.en: In Caer Darrow, by the lake, the ghosts of its former townsfolk still wander.

En Ciudad Manitas, dentro de Forjaz, viv.en: In Tinker Town, inside Ironforge, live the gnomes who escaped Gnomeregan.

En Combate tienes el medidor de daño del.en: In Combat you have the group damage meter and the rotation helper for your class.

En Comercio ves precios de la subasta y.en: In Trade you see auction prices and what's worth selling. I sell the grey items for you at the vendor.

En Comercio, en «Oficios», cada uno tien.en: In Trade, in "Professions", each one has its 1 to 300 guide: what to do at each stretch, what you're missing and where to learn the next rank.

En Comercio, en «Tu lista de compras», a.en: In Trade, in "Your shopping list", add a recipe or a profession: I tell you how much you have, how much you're missing and where it comes from. It fills itself as you gather.

En Comercio, «Tus recetas que dejan gana.en: In Trade, "Your recipes that make a profit" tells you how much each recipe earns with your realm's prices, with the ones you can already make first.

En Costa Oscura la Liga de Expedicionari.en: In Darkshore the Explorers' League digs up giant fossils.

En Costa Oscura viven lechúcicos, criatu.en: Moonkin live in Darkshore, half-owl, half-bear creatures that revere the moon.

En Cuna del Invierno la nieve no se acab.en: In Winterspring the snow never ends. The bears and yetis are in a good mood.

En Curación, «Curar y seleccionar» viene.en: In Healing, "Heal and target" comes on: every healing click on your frames also makes that teammate your target, so you can follow with a buff or remove a curse. In "Your clicks" you pick what each click does.

En Desolace está el cementerio de los ko.en: Desolace holds the Kodo Graveyard, where old kodos go to die.

En Dun Morogh la nieve brilla con el sol.en: In Dun Morogh the snow sparkles in the sun. Bundle up: even the bears are cold here.

En Durotar ya te topas con el Filo Ardie.en: In Durotar you already run into the Burning Blade, a cult of orc warlocks who still worship the demons.

En Elwynn, una señora vende gatitos de c.en: In Elwynn, a lady sells pet kittens. I get along with cats... almost always!

En Entrañas venden cucarachas de mascota.en: In the Undercity they sell cockroaches as pets. To each their own.

En Feralas está uno de los grandes árbol.en: Feralas holds one of the great trees through which the green dragons enter the Emerald Dream.

En Forever, Onyxia, la Cumbre Hyjal y Ba.en: In Forever, Onyxia, Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps give Legacy challenges when you defeat them.

En Forever, el banco vende casillas de b.en: In Forever, the bank sells bag slots one after another: more room for your treasures.

En Forever, los rangos de honor y la rep.en: In Forever, honor ranks and battleground reputation also give Legacy challenges.

En Forever, los retos del Legado dan pun.en: In Forever, Legacy challenges give points to your whole account, and each character spends them in their trees. Open it with the Y key.

En Forjaz, la sala de la Liga de Expedic.en: In Ironforge, the Explorers' League hall has a museum with huge fossils. Brann Bronzebeard is its most famous explorer.

En Gadgetzan, el cocinero Dirge enseña u.en: In Gadgetzan, the cook Dirge teaches one of Classic's best recipes, made with chimaerok meat.

En Hoy, en «¿Cuánto tiempo tienes?», eli.en: On Today, in "How much time do you have?", pick 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 or whatever you like. I build your plan at your pace and, with "Start", the arrow takes you step by step.

En Jaedenar se esconde el Consejo de la.en: The Shadow Council, warlocks serving the Burning Legion, hides in Jaedenar.

En Jardín Noble se esconden huevos de co.en: During Noblegarden, colorful eggs are hidden around the starting towns; inside there are sweets and sometimes spring clothes.

En Kharanos, la posada y la destilería C.en: In Kharanos, the inn and the Thunderbrew Distillery are the must-stop places to warm up... inside and out.

En La Jauría > Guaridas te digo en cuál.en: In La Jauría > Dens I tell you which one you're in and where the pack is. With "Ask to enter" you move to the den of a wolf with the door open.

En La Jauría > Guaridas toca «Llamar a l.en: In La Jauría > Dens tap "Call the pack" (or type /alfa manada llamar): the wolves in your zone get your spot and I tell you who's coming.

En La Jauría está «El tablón de la manad.en: La Jauría has "The pack board": post what you're looking for and your guild gets it. It goes away on its own after an hour.

En La Jauría está «La semana de la manad.en: La Jauría has "The pack's week": quests, rares, dungeons and levels of the wolves who share it. Nobody competes: it all adds up.

En La Jauría ves a tu grupo y a los lobo.en: In La Jauría you see your group and the wolves who show themselves on the map. You can follow them with the arrow or invite them.

En La Jauría ves cómo va. Si se atora, t.en: See how they're doing in La Jauría. If they get stuck, I'll tell you.

En La Jauría, en «Citas de la manada», e.en: In La Jauría, under "Pack outings", write what, pick a day and time and press "Propose". Your guild gets it with "I'm in" and I remind you 15 minutes before.

En La Jauría, en «¿Quién tiene...?», esc.en: In La Jauría, under "Who has...?", type the item and press "Search". The wolves in your guild who allow it answer, with "Whisper" to ask them for it.

En La Jauría, «El calendario de la manad.en: In La Jauría, "The pack calendar" lays out the meetups of the next seven days.

En La Jauría, «Las guaridas de la manada.en: In La Jauría, "The pack's dens" tells how many wolves are in each den of each zone. It shows on the map too.

En Los Baldíos el sol pega duro. Las ceb.en: In the Barrens the sun hits hard. Zhevras run everywhere and I want to chase them.

En Los Humedales siempre está húmedo. Mi.en: It's always damp in the Wetlands. My paws end up full of mud.

En Mazmorras ves cuáles van con tu nivel.en: In Dungeons you see which ones fit your level, their bosses, loot, quests and how to reach the entrance.

En Molino Ámbar se refugian magos de Dal.en: Dalaran mages take refuge in Ambermill, and they don't like visits from the Forsaken one bit.

En Mundo pones tus marcadores, los compa.en: In World you place your markers, share them with your group and the arrow takes you to them.

En Naxxramas, el gran Alexandros Mograin.en: In Naxxramas, the great Alexandros Mograine returns as one of the Scourge's Four Horsemen. What a sad fate for a hero.

En Nethergarde, unos magos de sangre te.en: At Nethergarde, some bloodmages trade you parts of the local beasts for elixirs that boost you for a good while.

En Orgrimmar, el Valle de la Sabiduría g.en: In Orgrimmar, the Valley of Wisdom holds Thrall's fortress, and the Valley of Honor gathers warriors and hunters.

En Paisaje y gráficos hay un paisaje más.en: In Scenery and graphics there's a nicer landscape in one click, and every graphics setting explained.

En Pesca tienes una sola tecla para equi.en: In Fishing you have a single key to gear up, cast and loot, a journal of your catches and a 1-300 guide.

En Pico Nidal manda el thane Falstad Mar.en: In Aerie Peak, Thane Falstad Wildhammer rules, lord of the gryphon riders.

En Pico Nidal viven los enanos Martillo.en: The Wildhammer dwarves live in Aerie Peak, famous for riding gryphons.

En Planes, abajo, «Abandonar una misión….en: In Plans, at the bottom, «Abandon a quest…»; or right-click the goal in the tracker. I ask before dropping it.

En Planes, «Fijar» en su tarjeta. Las fi.en: In Plans, «Pin» on its card. Pinned ones are never removed on their own to make room.

En Recolección eliges qué buscar y te ma.en: In Gathering you choose what to look for and I mark your professions' spots on the map, along with the ones you've found.

En Ruta eliges a dónde ir y yo te armo e.en: In Route you choose where to go and I build the path. The arrow takes you step by step and the tracker tells you what's next.
In Route you choose where to go and I build the path. The arrow takes you step by step and the tracker tells you what's next.

En Seradane hay uno de los grandes árbol.en: Seradane holds one of the great trees that lead into the Emerald Dream, and the green dragons guard it.

En Talentos te digo qué punto poner y po.en: In Talents I tell you which point to spend and why, for your class and how you play.

En Tanaris el sol del desierto no perdon.en: In Tanaris the desert sun is merciless. Gadgetzan is the only place with shade.

En Tanaris están las Cavernas del Tiempo.en: Tanaris holds the Caverns of Time, where Nozdormu's bronze dragonflight watches over history.

En Tirisfal casi nunca sale el sol. A lo.en: The sun hardly ever comes out in Tirisfal. The Forsaken don't even care.

En Tirisfal está la entrada al Monasteri.en: Tirisfal holds the entrance to the Scarlet Monastery, one of the places mid-level adventurers visit most.

En Tuercespina hace un calor de lobo. To.en: It's wolf-hot in Stranglethorn. Drink water and watch for tigers in the grass.

En Uldaman están los Discos de Norgannon.en: In Uldaman lie the Discs of Norgannon, titan records that tell how they made the earthen, the stone ancestors of the dwarves.

En Vallefresno, Grom Grito Infernal mató.en: In Ashenvale, Grom Hellscream killed the demigod Cenarius when the Horde began cutting down the forest.

En Vallefresno, Grom volvió a beber sang.en: In Ashenvale, Grom drank demon blood again; Thrall rescued him and Grom was able to redeem himself before he died.

En Ventormenta hay un barrio de enanos,.en: Stormwind has a dwarven district, a mage quarter and a park where the night elves gather.

En Warcraft III, si le das muchos clics.en: In Warcraft III, if you click a unit many times it starts saying funny things. I, on the other hand, give you tips.

En banda la lanza quien la dirige o sus.en: In a raid, the leader or their assistants start it.

En banda, un grupo por columna.en: In a raid, one group per column

En combate no aparece el cuadro de los p.en: In combat, the tooltip of characters and creatures in the world does not show (the unit frames' still does).
