Gear can't be changed in combat: I'll put "%s" on you when it ends.

En combate no se puede: espera a termina.en: You can't in combat: wait until it ends.

En combate solo cambian las armas; el re.en: In combat only your weapons change; the rest of your gear comes back when the fight ends.

En combate solo cambian las armas; lo de.en: In combat only your weapons change; the rest, when the fight ends.

En combate solo se pueden cambiar las ar.en: In combat only weapons can be swapped, and Alfa doesn't remember yours.

En combate · «A pelear» te pone tus arma.en: In combat · «To battle» puts your weapons on

En combate, el ícono muestra la habilida.en: In combat, the icon shows the ability Blizzard's assist suggests and the %d that come next. You decide what to press: Alfa never presses anything for you.
In combat, the icon shows the ability Blizzard's assist suggests. You decide what to press: Alfa never presses anything for you.

En combate, solo lo que dice Alfa: con q.en: In combat, only what Alfa says: which click removes that teammate's debuff. Without the game's details, so it doesn't get in the way.

En combate: espera a terminar.en: In combat: wait until it's over

En el Casco Antiguo está el SI:7, los es.en: Old Town houses SI:7, the spies and rogues in the kingdom's service.

En el Clásico mandan Thrall en Orgrimmar.en: In Classic, Thrall rules in Orgrimmar, Cairne in Thunder Bluff, Sylvanas in the Undercity and Vol'jin leads the Darkspear.

En el Clásico nadie sabe dónde anda Alam.en: In Classic nobody knows where Deathwing is; the ones who show their faces are his children, Onyxia and Nefarian.

En el Clásico necesitas flechas o balas:.en: In Classic you need arrows or bullets: always carry extra in your quiver or ammo pouch.

En el Clásico necesitas un cuchillo de d.en: In Classic you need a skinning knife in your bags.

En el Clásico solo puedes tener dos prof.en: In Classic you can only have two main professions, but Cooking, Fishing and First Aid are learned separately.

En el Clásico, Costasur contra Molino Ta.en: In Classic, Southshore versus Tarren Mill was the most famous faction fight in the world.

En el Clásico, a nivel 20 aprendes a tel.en: In Classic, at level 20 you learn to teleport to the capitals, and at 40 to open portals for others.

En el Clásico, a nivel 20 haces la misió.en: In Classic, at level 20 you do the poisons quest; afterwards you improve them with your trainer.

En el Clásico, a nivel 40 haces la misió.en: In Classic, at level 40 you do the quest for your warhorse, and at 60 the epic chain for the charger.

En el Clásico, a nivel 40 recibes un cor.en: In Classic, at level 40 you get a felsteed, and at 60 an epic chain in Dire Maul gives you an even more fearsome one.

En el Clásico, abrir las puertas de Ahn'.en: In Classic, opening the gates of Ahn'Qiraj took a server-wide war effort: mountains of materials and a very long quest chain.

En el Clásico, algunos peces solo pican.en: In Classic, some fish only bite at night or during the day.

En el Clásico, cada raza de sacerdote ti.en: In Classic, each priest race has a spell of its own. Ask your trainer which one is yours.

En el Clásico, después de vendarte queda.en: In Classic, after bandaging there's a while when you can't use another bandage.

En el Clásico, el Cetro de las Arenas Mo.en: In Classic, the Scepter of the Shifting Sands opened the gates of Ahn'Qiraj after a very long quest chain.

En el Clásico, el arco épico de los caza.en: In Classic, the hunters' epic bow comes from a chain against demons that starts in Moonglade.

En el Clásico, el chat de Los Baldíos er.en: In Classic, Barrens chat was famous for its endless conversations... and for asking where Mankrik's wife was.

En el Clásico, el nivel máximo es 60 y l.en: In Classic, the level cap is 60 and getting there takes time. That's why every level is worth celebrating.

En el Clásico, el rango de honor 14 es G.en: In Classic, honor rank 14 is Grand Marshal for the Alliance and High Warlord for the Horde.

En el Clásico, la Feria de la Luna Negra.en: In Classic, the Darkmoon Faire sometimes sets up in Mulgore, near Bloodhoof Village.
In Classic, the Darkmoon Faire sometimes sets up near Goldshire.

En el Clásico, la Horda la forman orcos,.en: In Classic, the Horde is made up of orcs, Darkspear trolls, tauren and Forsaken; the Alliance, of humans, dwarves, gnomes and night elves.

En el Clásico, la Plaga invadió el mundo.en: In Classic, the Scourge invaded the world with floating necropolises before Naxxramas opened.

En el Clásico, la actitud defensiva se g.en: In Classic, Defensive Stance comes from a quest at level 10, and Berserker Stance from another at level 30.

En el Clásico, la casa de subastas de Fo.en: In Classic, the Ironforge auction house is the busiest in the whole Alliance.

En el Clásico, la forma de oso se gana c.en: In Classic, bear form comes from a quest at level 10 and aquatic form from another at 16; then come cat and travel form.

En el Clásico, la montura de nivel 40 es.en: In Classic, the level 40 mount is much faster than running, and the level 60 epic one even more so.

En el Clásico, la tela se puede donar en.en: In Classic, you can donate cloth in your capital in exchange for reputation.

En el Clásico, las bandas grandes son de.en: In Classic, the big raids are for 40 players, and Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj for 20.

En el Clásico, los Renegados se quitan e.en: In Classic, the Forsaken shake off fear, charm and sleep with their willpower.

En el Clásico, los domingos por la tarde.en: In Classic, on Sunday afternoons Booty Bay held a fishing contest: the winner was the first to turn in forty fish of a special kind.

En el Clásico, los enanos pueden buscar.en: In Classic, dwarves can track treasure with a racial skill of their own. Perfect for finding chests!

En el Clásico, los enanos se convierten.en: In Classic, dwarves turn to stone to shrug off poisons and bleeds, and they're handy with firearms.

En el Clásico, los gnomos pueden ser gue.en: In Classic, gnomes can be warriors, rogues, mages or warlocks.

En el Clásico, los gnomos son más listos.en: In Classic, gnomes are smarter than the rest, have a knack for engineering and can slip free of whatever holds them in place.

En el Clásico, los humanos ganan reputac.en: In Classic, humans gain reputation faster thanks to their diplomacy, and have a keen eye for spotting stealthy foes.

En el Clásico, los maestros de armas de.en: In Classic, the weapon masters in the capitals teach you to use new weapons.

En el Clásico, los orcos resisten mejor.en: In Classic, orcs resist stuns better and their pets hit harder.

En el Clásico, los tauren tienen más vid.en: In Classic, tauren have extra health, a stomp that stuns nearby enemies and a green thumb with herbs.

En el Clásico, los trols se regeneran rá.en: In Classic, trolls regenerate quickly, go berserk, hit beasts harder and are handy with bows and throwing weapons.

En el Clásico, muchas comidas te dejan b.en: In Classic, many dishes leave you well fed and boost your stats for a good while.

En el Clásico, para pasar de 225 hay una.en: In Classic, to go past 225 there's a triage quest in Theramore or Hammerfall.

En el Clásico, quienes terminaron la cad.en: In Classic, those who finished the scepter chain and rang the gong of Ahn'Qiraj earned a unique title and mount.

En el Clásico, solo elfos de la noche y.en: In Classic, only night elves and tauren can be druids.

En el Clásico, solo humanos y enanos pue.en: In Classic, only humans and dwarves can be paladins.

En el Clásico, solo orcos, trols y taure.en: In Classic, only orcs, trolls and tauren can be shamans.

En el Clásico, tu Reencarnación te reviv.en: In Classic, your Reincarnation brings you back yourself, but it needs an ankh in your bags.

En el Enclave Cenarion los druidas enseñ.en: In the Cenarion Enclave the druids teach their own the way of nature.

En el Festival Lunar, la gente viene al.en: During the Lunar Festival, people come to Moonglade to honor their ancestors.

En el Festival Lunar, un emisario en las.en: During the Lunar Festival, an emissary in the capitals can take you to Moonglade to celebrate with the druids.

En el Festival de Fuego del Solsticio de.en: During the Midsummer Fire Festival there are bonfires in many towns: honoring your faction's gives rewards, and so does putting out the other's.

En el Festival de Invierno venden bolas.en: During Winter Veil they sell snowballs. Throw them at your friends, I'll catch them!

En el Festival de Invierno, el Gran Padr.en: During the Feast of Winter Veil, Greatfather Winter hands out gifts in Ironforge and Orgrimmar, and packages appear under the tree on the 25th.

En el Festival de la Cosecha, la Horda h.en: During the Harvest Festival, the Horde honors Grom Hellscream and the Alliance honors Uther, at their monuments.

En el Núcleo de Magma se desuellan perro.en: In the Molten Core, core hounds can be skinned for a very special leather.

En el Santuario Esmeralda, los druidas i.en: At the Emerald Sanctuary, the druids try to heal the sick forest.

En el Solsticio cada pueblo prende su ho.en: At Midsummer every town lights its bonfire. I love the smell of firewood... and roasted sausage.

En el Valle de Alterac pelean la Guardia.en: In Alterac Valley, the dwarves' Stormpike Guard fights the Frostwolf clan. I already know who I'm rooting for.

En el Valle de la Fuerza están el banco.en: The Valley of Strength holds the bank and the auction house: the heart of Horde trade.

En el centro de aquel Kalimdor estaba el.en: At the heart of that Kalimdor lay the Well of Eternity, a lake of pure magic. Trolls living on its shores changed over the centuries and became the night elves.

En el centro de la garganta hay un enorm.en: In the middle of the gorge lies a huge lava pit, the Cauldron, where the Dark Irons' slaves toil.

En el centro del cráter humea un volcán.en: In the middle of the crater smokes a volcano where fire elementals live.

En el corazón del Templo de la Luna hay.en: At the heart of the Temple of the Moon lies a moonwell, where the priestesses pray to Elune.

En el cráter, un tal Linken perdió la me.en: In the crater, a fellow named Linken lost his memory and is looking for his sword and shield: a nod to a certain pointy-eared hero.

En el cuadro de cada pieza de equipo: lo.en: In each gear tooltip: what you gain and lose against what you're wearing, with numbers.

En el este de las Tierras Inhóspitas viv.en: Black dragons and their servants live in the east of the Badlands. Keep your distance if you're on your own.

En el este del lago viven ogros que les.en: In the east of the loch live ogres who make life hard for the dwarves of Thelsamar.

En el gran salar del este, goblins y gno.en: On the great salt flats to the east, goblins and gnomes hold races; the rivalry is fierce.

En el lago de Villa del Lago hay múrlocs.en: There are murlocs in Lakeshire's lake, like in almost every lake in Azeroth!

En el mapa de Alfa, clic: seguirla con l.en: On Alfa's map, click: follow it with the arrow or save it as a marker.

En el mapa de Alfa, la capa «Peligros» m.en: On Alfa's map, the "Dangers" layer marks the elites and rares in your zone that can beat you: in red the ones far above your level. It's gathered when you open the map.

En el mapa de Alfa, la capa «Por descubr.en: On Alfa's map, the "Undiscovered" layer marks the corners of your zone you haven't visited, and "Missing flight paths" the flight masters you don't know yet. Click a flight path and the arrow takes you there.

En el mapa del mundo, cada zona con lobo.en: On the world map, each zone with wolves tells how many are in each den.

En el menú de una misión: toda su cadena.en: In a quest's menu: its whole chain, what you already did and the final reward.

En el muelle: sale en %s hacia %s.en: At the dock: leaves in %s for %s

En el nivel 10 domas tu bestia..en: You tame your beast at level 10.

En el norte de estas tierras, la Cruzada.en: In the north of these lands, the Scarlet Crusade holds a walled town and defends it fanatically.

En el oeste de Las Mil Agujas anidan dra.en: Wild wyverns nest in the west of Thousand Needles.

En el pueblo de los druidas del Claro de.en: Alliance and Horde live side by side in Moonglade's druid village: the Cenarion Circle welcomes everyone.

En el seguimiento: «+1,250 XP» junto a c.en: In the tracker: "+1,250 XP" next to each quest to hand in, and whether it levels you up.

En el sur de Desolace, demonios y sátiro.en: In southern Desolace, demons and satyrs gather in a coven.

En el sur de Tanaris hay colmenas de sil.en: In southern Tanaris there are silithid hives, cousins of the ones in Silithus.

En el sureste, la Mano de Tyr es la ciud.en: In the southeast, Tyr's Hand is the strongest city the Scarlet Crusade has left.

En esta página, cuánto llevas descubiert.en: On this page, how much of each zone on your continent you've discovered and what's left.

En esta página, lo que te sirve más en e.en: On this page, what's more useful in the bank or with another character: materials for their recipes, what their quests ask for and gear your class doesn't use.

En esta página, un buscador por las bols.en: On this page, a search through the bags, banks and gear of all your characters, with type, quality and character filters.

En estas laderas está Durnholde, donde A.en: Durnholde stands on these hills, where Aedelas Blackmoore raised Thrall as a gladiator.

En estas tierras cayó Anduin Lothar, el.en: Anduin Lothar, the Lion of Azeroth, fell in these lands during the Second War.

En estas tierras estuvo Strom, la capita.en: Strom, the capital of Arathor, the first great human kingdom, once stood in these lands.

En este pantano se hundió el Templo de A.en: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar sank in this swamp: the green dragons sank it to stop Hakkar's priests.

En estos días las calles se llenan de ca.en: These days the streets fill with pumpkins and candles. They scare me a tiny bit.

En forma de felino te vuelves sigiloso..en: In cat form you go stealthy. Sneak up unseen.

En forma de felino y por la espalda: muc.en: In cat form and from behind: lots of damage.

En forma de felino, un arañazo que hace.en: In cat form, a scratch that makes it bleed.

En forma de oso, golpea a varios enemigo.en: In bear form, hits several enemies nearby.

En grifo, la línea de tu vuelo en el map.en: On a gryphon, your flight's line on the map: where you are, where you land and the time left.

En grupo casi siempre hay varios enemigo.en: In a group there are almost always several enemies: you hit two at once.

En grupo o banda puedes lanzar la cuenta.en: In a group or raid you can start the pull countdown.

En grupo o con tu mascota: tu amenaza so.en: In a group or with your pet: your threat on your target. It warns you before you pull it off the tank or, if you're the tank, before you lose it.

En grupo o en una instancia..en: In a group or in an instance.

En grupo salen las 5 de tu grupo. Tu fil.en: In a group, the 5 of your group show. Your row is always visible.

En grupo y aguantando: Furia justa te da.en: In a group and tanking: Righteous Fury gives you more threat.

En grupo, Alfa muestra una barra pequeña.en: In a group, Alfa shows a small bar with your threat on your target. It turns yellow before you pull it off the tank and red if it's already attacking you. If you're the tank, it warns you when someone is about to take it.

En grupo, abre Combate y usa «Lanzar la.en: In a group, open Combat and use "Start the countdown": the game counts 10 seconds for everyone. When someone starts it, Alfa shows it to you big.

En grupo, al seleccionar un raro sin mar.en: In a group, when you target an unmarked rare, Alfa offers to put the skull on it with one click: your whole group sees it. In a raid, if you're leader or assistant.

En grupo, cura al tanque antes que a nad.en: In a group, heal the tank before anyone else.

En grupo, cura al tanque primero y no sa.en: In a group, heal the tank first and don't pull monsters yourself.

En grupo, cura antes de que la vida baje.en: In a group, heal before health drops a lot: it's cheaper.

En grupo, deja tus tótems de maná y de c.en: In a group, place your mana and healing totems near the group.

En grupo, dónde está lo que pide cada mi.en: In a group, where each quest is done and who has it.

En grupo, en banda o en una mazmorra sal.en: In a group, a raid or a dungeon a small chart shows up by itself at the bottom right with everyone's damage. Right-click it to change what it measures or announce it; its X hides it until your next group. Also with /alfa dps.

En grupo, si alguien no tiene una misión.en: In a group, if someone doesn't have a quest you carry, the tracker tells you with "Share". One click and you offer it.
In a group, if someone doesn't have one of your quests, a button to share it.

En instancias, si pisas fuego, veneno o.en: In instances, if you step on fire, poison or something the boss leaves on the ground: a short red warning. If the game hides that data, it turns itself off.

En la Arena Gurubashi aparece de vez en.en: Every so often a chest appears in the Gurubashi Arena and everyone fights over it. Every wolf for themselves!

En la Feria canjeas vales por premios; l.en: At the Faire you trade tickets for prizes; you earn tickets by turning in things you crafted with your profession or gathered while hunting.

En la Feria de la Luna Negra, la adivina.en: At the Darkmoon Faire, Sayge the fortune teller asks you a few questions and gives you a fortune that boosts your stats for a good while.

En la Fortaleza de Grommash, Thrall reci.en: In Grommash Hold, Thrall receives anyone who comes; nearby stands Eitrigg, the old orc who befriended Tirion.

En la Guerra de las Arenas Movedizas, el.en: In the War of the Shifting Sands, Archdruid Fandral lost his son Valstann to the qiraji.

En la Segunda Guerra, la Horda sumó a lo.en: In the Second War, the Horde was joined by the Amani trolls, the ogres and enslaved red dragons.

En la Semana de los Niños, los huérfanos.en: During Children's Week, the orphans of Stormwind and Orgrimmar ask you to take them on outings; at the end they give you a pet.

En la Tercera Guerra, orcos, humanos y e.en: In the Third War, orcs, humans and elves joined forces here against Archimonde, and Nordrassil sacrificed its energy to destroy him.

En la Terraza de los Artesanos de Darnas.en: Darnassus's Craftsmen's Terrace holds the profession trainers.

En la Vega se encuentran páginas sueltas.en: Loose pages of a Nesingwary book turn up in the Vale; gather a full chapter and bring it to him.

En la batalla de Hyjal, Malfurion hizo s.en: In the battle of Hyjal, Malfurion sounded the Horn of Cenarius and thousands of wisps surrounded Archimonde until he was destroyed.

En la búsqueda de tus bolsas, «3 nuevos».en: In your bags' search, "3 new" and "1 upgrade": one click highlights just that.

En la casa de subastas, mira los precios.en: At the auction house, watch prices for a few days before selling: they change with the time of day and who's playing.

En la cima del Monte Hyjal crece Nordras.en: Nordrassil, the World Tree blessed by the dragons, grows atop Mount Hyjal.

En la costa de Durotar, soldados de Kul.en: On Durotar's coast, Kul Tiran soldiers hold Tiragarde Keep: a thorn stuck in the Horde's land.

En la costa de Tanaris se esconden pirat.en: Southsea pirates hide on the coast of Tanaris.

En la costa del pantano hay naga, y no r.en: There are naga on the swamp's coast, and they don't welcome the curious.

En la costa este vive una tribu trol ami.en: On the east coast lives a troll tribe friendly to the Horde and hostile to the trolls of Jintha'Alor.

En la costa oeste de Vallefresno, las Ca.en: On Ashenvale's west coast, Blackfathom Deeps was once a temple of Elune; today it's sunken and full of naga.

En la costa se ven ruinas de antiguos pa.en: Along the coast you can see ruins of ancient elven palaces, half sunk into the sea.

En la cueva del barco hay muchos piratas.en: The ship cave is full of pirates: don't all jump down to the dock at once.

En la excavación de Ironband, los troggs.en: At Ironband's Excavation Site, the troggs came up out of the ground and took over everything.

En la ficha de cada mazmorra está el bot.en: Each dungeon's page has every boss's loot and what upgrades your gear.

En la granja de los Saldean, la vieja ye.en: On the Saldean farm, old mare Blanchy needs oats. It's one of the sweetest quests in Westfall.

En la guarida de Onyxia, a los lados hay.en: In Onyxia's lair, the side nests are full of eggs: if someone steps on them, whelps come out... lots of them.

En la pelea, el juego te avisa.en: In the fight, the game warns you

En la pestaña de enviar, un botón por ca.en: On the send tab, one button per list: it fills in the name and attaches what's on that list. The click on «Send» is yours. Lists: /alfa comercio alt.

En la sala de la Liga de Expedicionarios.en: The Explorers' League hall in Ironforge has a library, maps and a museum full of giant fossils.

En la segunda parte mátenla a ella prime.en: In the second part kill her first: she heals a lot.

En la subasta cuenta el precio más bajo.en: For the auction house it counts the lowest price it saw, minus the cut (%d%%, estimated). For disenchanting it uses the classic game's tables, also estimated.

En la ventana de tu personaje y al inspe.en: On your character window and when you inspect someone: each piece's item level and, if it's wearing out, how much it has left.

En la ventana y aquí. Si no estás entre.en: In the window and here. If you're not among them, your row shows at the end.

En las Cuevas de los Lamentos, el druida.en: In the Wailing Caverns, the druid Naralex dreamed of making the Barrens green again, and his dream turned into a nightmare.

En las Guerras Trol, los altos elfos ens.en: In the Troll Wars, the high elves taught magic to a hundred humans so they could defeat the Amani together. They were humanity's first mages.

En las Mazmorras de Ventormenta los pres.en: In the Stormwind Stockade the prisoners rioted, and the guard is asking for help to settle the mess.

En las Pozas de la Visión, bajo una de l.en: In the Pools of Vision, beneath one of the mesas, the Forsaken mages and priests train.

En las cuevas de Cuna del Invierno viven.en: Shaggy, grumpy yetis live in Winterspring's caves.

En las cuevas de Feralas viven yetis, y.en: Yetis live in Feralas's caves, and the Gordunni ogres have their camps in the north.

En las cuevas nevadas de Dun Morogh vive.en: In Dun Morogh's snowy caves live ice trolls who don't like dwarves one bit.

En las granjas del oeste hay calderos de.en: On the western farms, Scourge cauldrons keep spreading the plague; the Alliance sends adventurers to destroy them.

En las ruinas de la ciudad de Alterac ho.en: Ogres and the Syndicate, a gang of the old kingdom's fallen nobles, now rule the ruins of Alterac City.

En lo alto de la sierra hay un pico sagr.en: High in the range is a peak sacred to the elven druids, where huge birds nest.

En lo más alto de la Montaña Roca Negra.en: Nefarian, son of Deathwing, rules from the very top of Blackrock Mountain.

En los Páramos de Poniente el viento mue.en: In Westfall the wind turns the windmills. Watch out for the Defias on the farms.

En los canales, la misma persona con el.en: In channels, the same person with the same message within a minute shows only once.

En los marcos de Alfa manda tu mapa de c.en: On Alfa's frames your click map is in charge; your Blizzard shortcuts don't apply here.

En mazmorras y bandas el juego a veces n.en: In dungeons and raids the game sometimes won't say what the enemy is casting: it plays a softer sound, and sometimes also for things that can't be interrupted.

En mazmorras y bandas, si pisas fuego, v.en: In dungeons and raids, if you step on fire, poison or something a boss leaves on the ground, Alfa tells you "Get out of there!" in red with a sound. Turn it off in Combat, in Settings.

En mazmorras y en combate Lya se hace ch.en: In dungeons and in combat Lya gets small, stays quiet and stays out of your clicks. She comes back afterwards.

En memoria de una gran perrita.en: In memory of a wonderful little dog

En orco, «Lok'tar ogar» quiere decir «vi.en: In Orcish, «Lok'tar ogar» means «victory or death».

En pausa: hay otro addon de pesca activo.en: Paused: another fishing addon is enabled

En plena Segunda Guerra, Gul'dan abandon.en: In the middle of the Second War, Gul'dan abandoned the Horde to seek the Tomb of Sargeras. The demons he found there tore him apart.

En posadas y ciudades acumulas XP descan.en: In inns and towns you build up rested XP: you earn double XP per enemy until it is spent. Logging out here builds it up too.

En posadas y ciudades juntas XP descansa.en: In inns and cities you build rested XP: double XP per enemy until it runs out.

En solitario es lento: usa la varita par.en: Solo it's slow: use your wand to finish them off.

En solitario, deja curas que duran en el.en: Solo, put on heals over time and fight with Wrath.

En solitario, pelea con choques y cúrate.en: Solo, fight with shocks and heal yourself between monsters.

En su ficha toca «Agregar a mi ruta»..en: On its page, tap "Add to my route".

En sus inicios, una batalla del Valle de.en: In its early days, an Alterac Valley battle could last hours... and even days!

If you say yes, La Jauría wolves who use Alfa see your character on the WoW map, like you see your group, and can reach you with the arrow; and you them. Alfa only shares where your character is inside the game: the zone, the spot on the map, its level and class. Never your real location, your computer or your account.

Es opcional: tu personaje aparece en el.en: It's optional: your character shows on the WoW map of La Jauría wolves who use Alfa, and theirs on yours, to find each other and reach them with the arrow. Only where your character is inside the game is shared (zone, spot on the map, level and class), never your real location or anything from your computer, and never inside dungeons. It goes through a hidden channel that doesn't show in chat, though someone who joins it with another addon could see it. Your group always shows. Change it any time in La Jauría.

A rare spawn in the Graveyard, not always there. He can silence casters.

Write something and press "Note here": it stays on your map where you stand. "Spot here" marks a good farming place, in gold. Click the mark and the arrow takes you there.

Junto a la ventana de tu personaje, un b.en: Next to your character window, one button per set. In combat it swaps your weapons right away and the rest when the fight ends. Right-click: put it on after every fight.

Junto a tu guía hay un botón para buscar.en: Next to your guide there's a button to find what's nearby: flights, bank, auction house, repairs, vendors and trainers.

Junto al botón, el nombre del objeto y c.en: Next to the button, the item's name and your progress; a paw print pulses when you can use it.

Junto al título de cada página. Tócalo y.en: Next to every page's title. Tap it and I'll explain that page with its questions.

Kael'thas fue miembro del Kirin Tor de D.en: Kael'thas was a member of Dalaran's Kirin Tor before he led the blood elves.

Karazhan, la torre de Medivh, el último.en: Karazhan, the tower of Medivh, the last Guardian, rises over a crossing of natural ley lines.

Kargath, el campamento de la Horda, llev.en: Kargath, the Horde camp, is named after an old orc chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan.

Kel'Thuzad era un archimago de Dalaran..en: Kel'Thuzad was an archmage of Dalaran. He was expelled for studying necromancy and ended up serving the Lich King.

Kel'Thuzad tiene un gato, el señor Biggl.en: Kel'Thuzad has a cat, Mr. Bigglesworth, who keeps him company in Naxxramas. Don't you dare hurt him!

Khadgar fue el aprendiz de Medivh. Al pe.en: Khadgar was Medivh's apprentice. Fighting his possessed master aged him in an instant and left his hair white.

Khaz Modan es la tierra de los enanos, d.en: Khaz Modan is the land of the dwarves, from the snows of Dun Morogh to the valleys of Loch Modan.

Kil'jaeden encerró el alma de Ner'zhul e.en: Kil'jaeden sealed Ner'zhul's soul in a block of ice and hurled it to Northrend: that is how the Lich King was born.

Kil'jaeden engañó a Ner'zhul, el chamán.en: Kil'jaeden deceived Ner'zhul, Draenor's wisest shaman, and his apprentice Gul'dan finished handing the orcs over to the Legion.

Korialstrasz, el consorte de Alexstrasza.en: Korialstrasz, Alexstrasza's consort, walked among mortals as Krasus, a mage of Dalaran's council.

Kul Tiras es un reino isleño de marinero.en: Kul Tiras is an island kingdom of sailors. Its grand admiral, Daelin Proudmoore, was Jaina's father.

La %s también está en el menú del juego..en: The %s is also in the game menu.

La Abadía de Villanorte es de las más an.en: Northshire Abbey is one of the oldest in the kingdom; many human adventurers begin their journey there.

La Alianza nació en la Segunda Guerra, c.en: The Alliance was born in the Second War, when the human kingdoms, the dwarves and the high elves united against the Horde.

La B, Mayús+B, la tecla de cada bolsa y.en: B, Shift+B, each bag's key and vendors open Alfa's window. Turn it off to go back to the game's.

La Capilla de la Esperanza de la Luz res.en: Light's Hope Chapel held out against the Scourge in a legendary battle; today it's the Argent Dawn's great refuge.

La Catedral de la Luz es el corazón de l.en: The Cathedral of Light is the heart of the faith in Stormwind; its priests serve the whole Alliance.

La Cresta de la Llama es el puesto de la.en: Flame Crest is the Horde outpost in the steppes, high up on the rocks.

La Cruzada Escarlata nació del dolor de.en: The Scarlet Crusade was born from Lordaeron's grief after the plague, but its hatred made it as cruel as what it fights.

La Cruzada Escarlata tiene aquí su monas.en: The Scarlet Crusade has its monastery here. To them every undead must burn, the Forsaken included.

La Cuenca de Arathi, el campo de batalla.en: Arathi Basin, the battleground, lies in these lands: they fight over the farm, the mine, the lumber mill, the stables and the blacksmith.

La Feria de la Luna Negra tiene su propi.en: The Darkmoon Faire has its own reputation, raised with its tickets and errands.

La Fortaleza de Grommash, en Orgrimmar,.en: Grommash Hold, in Orgrimmar, bears the name of Grom Hellscream, the hero who freed the orcs from the demon blood.

La Fuente del Sol, el corazón de Quel'Th.en: The Sunwell, the heart of Quel'Thalas, was born from a vial of Well of Eternity water the high elves took with them.

La Garganta de Fuego quedó así por culpa.en: The Searing Gorge is the Dark Iron's doing: their sorcerer-thane Thaurissan summoned Ragnaros and the land caught fire.

La Gran Forja nunca se apaga: es el cora.en: The Great Forge never goes out: it's the heart of Ironforge and your people's pride.

La Gran Forja, en el corazón de Forjaz,.en: The Great Forge, at the heart of Ironforge, never goes out.

La Guardia Nocturna es la milicia de Vil.en: The Night Watch is Darkshire's militia: it protects the town from wolves, undead and worgen.

La Guerra de los Ancestros fue la primer.en: The War of the Ancients was the Burning Legion's first invasion of Azeroth, about ten thousand years ago.

La Hermandad del Torio son enanos Hierro.en: The Thorium Brotherhood are Dark Iron dwarves who broke away from their clan. They're master smiths and deal with anyone who respects them.

La Hermandad del Torio, en La Garganta d.en: The Thorium Brotherhood, in the Searing Gorge, teaches plans many blacksmiths dream of.

La Horda arrasó Ventormenta en la Primer.en: The Horde razed Stormwind in the First War. The stonemasons who rebuilt it were never paid, and the Defias Brotherhood was born from that anger.

La Horda tiene su propio pueblo al norte.en: The Horde has its own village north of the marsh, to keep a close eye on Theramore.

La Horda tiene una aldea en la costa de.en: The Horde has a village on the Desolace coast, and the Alliance a camp in the northern mountains.

La Jauría más cuidadosa y Alfa más liger.en: A more careful La Jauría and a lighter Alfa: the group map, boats and your bags do less work.

La Jauría: tu manada en el mapa, Seguir.en: La Jauría: your pack on the map, Follow and the clan (/alfa manada help)

La Legión Ardiente es el ejército de dem.en: The Burning Legion is the demon army of Sargeras, a fallen titan who wants to burn all of creation.

La Liga de Arathor y los Rapiñadores se.en: The League of Arathor and the Defilers fight over Arathi Basin; the Silverwing Sentinels and the Warsong Outriders, over Warsong Gulch.

La Liga de Expedicionarios, los arqueólo.en: The Explorers' League, Ironforge's archaeologists, searches the world for ruins that tell the dwarves' origins.

La Luz para los humanos y enanos, Elune.en: The Light for humans and dwarves, Elune for night elves and shadow for many Forsaken: each priest serves something different.

La Mano de Plata la fundó el arzobispo A.en: The Silver Hand was founded by Archbishop Alonsus Faol, and Uther was its first paladin.

La Mano de Plata, la orden de paladines,.en: The Silver Hand, the order of paladins, was founded by Archbishop Alonsus Faol, and Uther was the first of its knights.

La Masacre fue Eldre'Thalas, una ciudad.en: Dire Maul was Eldre'Thalas, a city of the Highborne elves from before the Great Sundering.

La Milicia Popular de la Colina del Cent.en: The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill was formed by the farmers themselves when Stormwind stopped sending soldiers.

La Montaña Roca Negra se alza entre esta.en: Blackrock Mountain rises between this gorge and the Burning Steppes. Inside live the Dark Iron dwarves, Ragnaros and the black dragons.

La Muralla de Thoradin separa Arathi de.en: Thoradin's Wall separates Arathi from the Hillsbrad Foothills; it bears the name of the king who united humanity.

La Orden de Tirisfal, los magos secretos.en: The Order of Tirisfal, the secret mages who chose Azeroth's Guardian, took its name from these glades. Medivh was the last Guardian.

La Plaga es el ejército no-muerto del Re.en: The Scourge is the Lich King's undead army. Kel'Thuzad spread it across Lordaeron with infected grain.

La Polimorfia convierte al enemigo en ov.en: Polymorph turns the enemy into a sheep. I'd behave very nicely with that sheep, wolf's honor.

La Segadora de arcanita es una de las ar.en: The Arcanite Reaper is one of the most famous weapons a blacksmith can forge.

La Sima Ígnea está bajo Orgrimmar: ahí s.en: Ragefire Chasm lies beneath Orgrimmar: cult warlocks hide there along with troggs.

La Sociedad Real de Boticarios trabaja e.en: The Royal Apothecary Society works on a new plague in the Undercity. Better not ask who it's for.
The Royal Apothecary Society secretly works on a new plague... and not just for the humans.

La Tercera Guerra empezó con la plaga de.en: The Third War began with the grain plague in Lordaeron and ended on Hyjal with Archimonde's fall.

La Torre de Azora, en el este de Elwynn,.en: The Tower of Azora, in eastern Elwynn, is home to Theocritus, a mage in the kingdom's service.

La aldea Sen'jin, en la costa de Durotar.en: Sen'jin Village, on Durotar's coast, bears the name of the leader who gave his life for his people.

La barra con el nombre de la zona y la h.en: The bar with the zone name and the time takes the style's colours and font. The tracking, calendar and mail buttons stay as usual.

La barra de acción, las barras extra, la.en: The action bar, the extra bars, the experience bar, the menu and the bags take the style you choose. Only their look changes, out of combat; turning it off brings back the game's own.

La barra de tu vuelo con sus paradas sal.en: Your flight bar with its stops always shows when you take off.

La barra de vida con el color de la clas.en: The health bar in each member's class color. Off: a green bar and the name in their color.

La base de datos de Alfa no está cargada.en: Alfa's database isn't loaded. Try again in a moment.

La base incluida trae %s lugares en %d z.en: The included database has %s spots in %d zones. You found %s.

La bienvenida con las novedades de esta.en: The welcome with what's new in this version.

La bienvenida ocupa toda la pantalla, co.en: The setup fills the whole screen, with the game dimmed behind it.

La básica la venden los instructores y l.en: Trainers and fishing supplies vendors sell the basic one.

La búsqueda de lugares cercanos no está.en: Nearby places search is not available.

La cadena de los Defias te lleva de Vill.en: The Defias chain takes you from Goldshire to Westfall and ends in the Deadmines, face to face with VanCleef.

La cadena no trae talentos válidos..en: The string has no valid talents.

La caja donde escribes toma el estilo, c.en: The box you type in takes the style, with the accent border while you type. In Classic WoW the game's own box stays.

La cambiaste fuera de Alfa (menú del jue.en: You changed it outside Alfa (game menu or console).

La capa de escamas de Onyxia protege del.en: The Onyxia Scale Cloak protects against Nefarian's breath, and everyone in his raid needs one.

La carta ya está llena: manda esta y pre.en: The letter is full: send this one and prepare another.

La cerveza es casi sagrada para tu gente.en: Beer is almost sacred to your people: the Thunderbrew Distillery is in Kharanos.

La compra es tuya: Alfa no compra ni puj.en: The purchase is yours: Alfa never buys or bids.

La configuración es más visual: tres tar.en: Setup is more visual: three cards to decide how much Alfa helps you, and your extras in a tile grid.

La cura de ese clic pasa al botón centra.en: That click's heal moves to the middle button.

La cámara no salta hacia ti por cada árb.en: The camera doesn't jump toward you for every tree or post between it and your character.

La cámara se mece un poco con tus pasos..en: The camera sways slightly with your steps.

La cámara se queda sobre el agua en luga.en: The camera stays above water instead of going under.

La de ahora pasa a tus sesiones anterior.en: The current one moves to your past sessions.
The current one moves to your past sessions. Your journal and achievements don't change.

La de tu clase mientras subes: cambia so.en: Your class's while you level: it changes by itself once you spend talents.

La de tu nivel. Antes, revisa que lleves.en: The one for your level. Check you have everything first.

La dirección del texto sobre tu personaj.en: The direction of the text over your character.

La entrada de cada mazmorra en el minima.en: Each dungeon's entrance on the minimap, in green the ones you've done. The world map already marks them with "Dungeon entrances".

La esquina de abajo a la derecha la hace.en: The bottom-right corner makes it taller. Alfa opens it where you left it, as tall as you left it.

La familia Barov le entregó su castillo.en: The Barov family handed their castle at Caer Darrow to the Cult in exchange for eternal life. That's how Scholomance was born, and look how it went for them.

La flecha con el estilo de La Jauría, y.en: The arrow in La Jauría's style, and "How much time do you have?" builds your plan step by step.

La flecha no está disponible ahora..en: The arrow isn't available right now.

La flecha se mueve con su rastro y se de.en: The arrow moves with their trail and stops when you arrive.

La flecha sigue caminos por el suelo alr.en: The arrow follows paths on the ground around cliffs, water and walls, on Alfa's walking maps. Off: it points straight at each stop.

La flecha te lleva a este paso, no al de.en: The arrow takes you to this step, not the current one.

La flecha te lleva a su entrada..en: The arrow takes you to its entrance.

La flecha te lleva al primer paso. En Ho.en: The arrow takes you to the first step. Today shows how far along you are and "Next" moves on.

La flecha te lleva de un lugar al siguie.en: The arrow takes you from one spot to the next.

La flecha tomó otro destino: dejaste de.en: The arrow took another destination: you stopped following %s.

La flecha usa vuelos y tu piedra de hoga.en: The arrow uses flights and your Hearthstone when it pays off.

La flecha ya no sigue tu ruta para junta.en: The arrow no longer follows your gathering route.

La fuerza se cambia en la ventana, en Fi.en: Change its strength in the window, under Filters.

La guarida de Onyxia está en este marjal.en: Onyxia's lair is in this marsh. Onyxia, Deathwing's daughter, poses as a human noblewoman in Stormwind.

La guarida se queda contigo aunque salga.en: The den stays with you even if you leave.

La guía de Pesca te dice a qué agua ir s.en: The Fishing guide tells you which water to go to for your fishing skill, and the arrow takes you there.

La guía que mejor te queda por tu nivel.en: The guide that fits you best for your level and where you are.

La guía que sigues, tu paso de ahora y t.en: The guide you follow, your step now and everything about guides one click away.

La guía te lleva a entrenar en %d pasos..en: The guide takes you to train in %d steps.

La guía te lleva a quien recibe cada una.en: The guide takes you to whoever takes each one.

La haces de paso: abre %s..en: You do it on the way: it opens %s.

La historia de Alfa y de La Jauría, el D.en: The story of Alfa and La Jauría, the Discord, the commands and the credits.

La historia se guarda cuando el juego te.en: The story is saved when the game shows you the quest.

La hora de tu computadora. Clic: abre Ho.en: Your computer's time. Click: opens Today.

La hora, la fiesta y el lugar.en: The time, the holiday and the place

La lengua de la Alianza es el común y la.en: The Alliance speaks Common and the Horde speaks Orcish. That's why what you say to the other faction reaches them as gibberish.

La letra del aspecto (Inter en el de Alf.en: The skin's font (Inter in Alfa's own look, Fira Sans in Halo, the game's in the others) or one you choose.

La lista de compras es de Comercio: actí.en: The shopping list belongs to Trade: enable it to use it.

La lista por nivel y tu progreso..en: The list by level and your progress.

La lista queda vacía. Lo que Alfa te dig.en: The list is emptied. What Alfa tells you later shows up here again.

La llegada de la flecha, nueva; circuito.en: A brand-new arrow arrival; a zone circuit and "Take me to..." with flights and boats.

La luna ya va bajando. Si cabeceas, desc.en: The moon is going down. If you're nodding off, rest at an inn and earn rested experience.

La lupa de la cabecera del rastreador ab.en: The magnifier in the tracker's header opens the menu. Also: /alfa cerca or your key.

La línea de tiempo de Blizzard dice qué.en: Blizzard's timeline says which attack is coming and when, and the big messages say what's dangerous. Alfa doesn't invent warnings: you turn them on and adjust them in Settings.

La línea de tu personaje ya no se corta:.en: Your character line no longer gets cut: if it doesn't fit, it drops parts and never your name or level.

La línea del camino también en el minima.en: The route line on the minimap too.

La manada en el mapa, cazar juntos, el s.en: The pack on the map, hunting together, the greeting at login and the skull for the rare in one click.

La manada es fuerte porque cada lobo lo.en: The pack is strong because every wolf is. And you are.

La manada no te ve en el mapa.en: The pack doesn't see you on the map

La manada no ve a tu personaje en el map.en: The pack doesn't see your character on the map.

La manada sabe qué misiones llevas (solo.en: The pack knows which quests you have (just which ones) and you know theirs. If a wolf in your zone is doing one with you, their card says so and Lya suggests inviting them.

La manada se organiza y tu historia.en: The pack gets organized, and your story

La manada te ve en el mapa.en: The pack sees you on the map

La manada te ve en el mapa: %s.en: The pack sees you on the map: %s

La manada ya no ve a tu personaje en el.en: The pack no longer sees your character on the map.

La manada ya ve a tu personaje en el map.en: The pack now sees your character on the game map.
The pack now sees your character on the game map. Change it any time with /alfa manada.

La mazmorra para tu nivel, sus jefes, bo.en: The dungeon for your level, its bosses, loot, quests and tips.

La mazmorra para tu nivel, sus misiones.en: The dungeon for your level, its quests and how to get there.

La mazmorra para tu nivel: jefes, botín.en: The dungeon for your level: bosses, loot and tips.

La mazmorra para tu nivel; con un nombre.en: The dungeon for your level; with a name, that dungeon (also: progreso, ajustes)

La mañana huele a pan recién hecho en la.en: The morning smells of fresh bread at the inns. Shall we start with the easy quests?

La mejor de tus bolsas.en: The best one in your bags

La niebla con cuerpo de valles, pantanos.en: The thick fog of valleys, swamps and sunrises.

La noche en Los Baldíos es enorme y call.en: The night in the Barrens is huge and quiet. You can hear hyenas in the distance.

La noche en Tirisfal es más fría que el.en: Night in Tirisfal is colder than the day. It smells of wet leaves and crypts.

La nueva ya arrancó: sigue la flecha..en: The new one has started: follow the arrow.

La pantalla se pone negra uno o dos segu.en: The screen goes black for a second or two while the game restarts its graphics. You don't leave the game or lose anything.

La pesca se rehízo: una sola tecla para.en: Fishing was rebuilt: one key to gear up, cast and loot, with a journal, achievements and a 1–300 guide.

La piedra de hogar, clara: a dónde vuelv.en: A clear hearthstone: where you go back to, what you turn in and a button to use it.

La piel verde de los orcos es una huella.en: The orcs' green skin is a mark of the fel magic their warlocks used on Draenor.

La pieza más gastada de lo que llevas pu.en: The most worn piece you are wearing. When it is low, time to repair. Click: opens Today.

La precisión es lo más importante: con d.en: Hit is the most important stat: with two weapons you miss a lot without it.

La primera vence en %s. Tómala antes de.en: The first one expires in %s. Take it before it goes back to the sender or is lost.

La primera vez que pisas un lugar: un de.en: The first time you set foot somewhere: a golden flash, the experience you earned and something Lya knows about that zone.

La princesa Moira, hija de Magni Barbabr.en: Princess Moira, Magni Bronzebeard's daughter, lives in Blackrock Depths as Emperor Thaurissan's wife.

La página de Bolsas; «abrir» abre tus bo.en: The Bags page; "open" opens your bags and "bank" your bank

La página de Bolsas; «abrir», «banco», «.en: The Bags page; "abrir" (open), "banco" (bank), "conjunto <name>" (wear a set) and "guardar <name>" (save a set)

La que te toca, con sus misiones y su bo.en: The one for you, with its quests and loot.

La recomendada para ti y todas las demás.en: The one recommended for you and all the others
The one recommended for you and all the others.

La ruta más rápida desde tu nivel, misió.en: The fastest route from your level, quest by quest.

La ruta te lleva a %s. La flecha está ap.en: The route takes you to %s. The arrow is turned off: turn it on in Settings > Guide to see it.

La ruta ya no se salta para siempre una.en: The route no longer skips forever a quest it can't check yet.

La sacas de tu plan..en: You take it out of your plan.

La sastrería usa la tela que sueltan los.en: Tailoring uses the cloth humanoids drop: linen, wool, silk, mageweave and runecloth.

La selva de Tuercespina de noche suena a.en: The Stranglethorn jungle at night sounds like a thousand bugs. The trolls do see in the dark.

La siguiente casilla cuesta %s y no te a.en: The next slot costs %s and you can't afford it yet.

La siguiente casilla cuesta %s: cómprala.en: The next slot costs %s: buy it with the game's bank button, now on screen.

La subasta deja escanear todo cada 15 mi.en: The auction house allows a full scan every 15 minutes. %s to go.

La subasta no aceptó el escaneo. Intenta.en: The auction house didn't accept the scan. Try again later.

La subasta no envió subastas. Intenta de.en: The auction house sent no auctions. Try again later.

La subasta no respondió. Puede que aún e.en: The auction house didn't answer. It may still be on cooldown: try again in a few minutes.

La suma de lo que guardó Alfa de cada pe.en: The sum of what Alfa saved for each character (yours, up to date).

La tarde se presta para una mazmorra con.en: The afternoon is perfect for a dungeon with the pack. More people are online at this hour.

La tecla del botón de tu barra con esa h.en: The key of the button on your bar with that ability, on the icon.

La tecla del mapa abre este mapa.en: The map key opens this map

La tecla que abre el mapa del juego (M).en: The key that opens the game's map (M) opens Alfa's; in it, a button takes you to the game's. Turn it off and the key opens the game's map again. You can also give it its own key in Options > Keybindings > Alfa.

La tecla que usabas en tu otro addon de.en: The key you used in your other fishing addon (%s) now fishes with Alfa.

La tela rúnica sale de humanoides de niv.en: Runecloth comes from level 50+ humanoids: the trolls of the Hinterlands or the satyrs of Felwood are a good choice.

La tela sale de los enemigos humanoides.en: Cloth drops from humanoid enemies of your level. Tailoring suppliers sell the thread.

La tela vil sale de sátiros y demonios d.en: Felcloth comes from satyrs and demons in Felwood and Azshara.

La tribu Zandalar se considera la primer.en: The Zandalar tribe sees itself as the first of all trolls. Their priests camp on Yojamba Isle to stop Hakkar.

La trituradora tira a la gente: vuelve a.en: The shredder knocks people around: get its attention back fast.

La tuya tiene %d semanas: salen seguido..en: Yours is %d weeks old: updates come often.

La varilla de cobre la venden los provee.en: Enchanting suppliers sell the copper rod.

La venta de oro no sale en tu chat. Nunc.en: Gold selling does not show in your chat. Your friends, guild and group are never filtered. What was hidden can be seen (/alfa filtrado).

La ventana de Alfa se estira hacia abajo.en: Alfa's window stretches down, remembers where you left it and has shortcuts: Ctrl and a number, Ctrl+F and "‹" to go back.

Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz gobierna a los.en: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner rules the Forsaken. She was Ranger-General of Quel'Thalas before Arthas killed her.

Lady Vashj, que fue dama de compañía de.en: Lady Vashj, once one of Azshara's handmaidens, now leads her naga in Illidan's service.

Lanza bolas de fuego y fuego a su alrede.en: He casts fireballs and fire around him: interrupt him and, if ranged, stay away.

Lanza bombas de humo que aturden: sal de.en: He throws smoke bombs that stun: get out of the smoke.

Lanza enredaderas que tumban a todos los.en: He casts vines that knock down everyone near him: ranged players, stay back.

Lanza fuego a su alrededor: si peleas de.en: He sends out fire around him: ranged players, stay away from him.

Lanza hechizos de tierra y pone tótems:.en: He casts earth spells and drops totems: break the totems first.

Lanza metal fundido: si no tanqueas, no.en: He throws molten metal: if you're not the tank, don't stand next to him.

Lanza rayos y se puede curar: interrumpe.en: She casts lightning and can heal herself: interrupt her spells.

Lanza ráfagas arcanas: interrúmpelo..en: He casts arcane bursts: interrupt him.

Lanza sombras: interrúmpelo..en: He casts shadow spells: interrupt him.

Lanza telarañas y una maldición: quita l.en: He shoots webs and casts a curse: remove the curse if you can.

Lanza tormentas de arena que se mueven p.en: He creates sandstorms that move around the room: don't stand in them.

Lanza tu hechizo más fuerte desde lejos.en: Cast your strongest spell from afar and finish with the instant ones.

Lanza tu hechizo más fuerte primero y re.en: Cast your strongest spell first and finish with a shock.

Lanza una nube de veneno hacia adelante:.en: She breathes a poison cloud in front of her: turn her away from the group.

Lanza una red que deja quieto a un jugad.en: He throws a net that holds a player in place: not a problem, keep attacking.

Lanza veneno a todos: quita el veneno si.en: He hits everyone with poison: remove it if you can.

Las Cavernas del Tiempo guardan los mome.en: The Caverns of Time hold history's most important moments, and the Bronze Flight won't let anyone change them.

Las Estepas Ardientes se incendiaron cua.en: The Burning Steppes caught fire when Ragnaros awoke, and their embers still haven't gone out.

Las Islas del Eco eran el hogar de los L.en: The Echo Isles were the Darkspear's home until the witch doctor Zalazane enslaved many with his voodoo and the rest had to move to the mainland.

Las Minas de la Muerte esconden el refug.en: The Deadmines hide VanCleef's hideout... and even a pirate ship.

Las Montañas Crestagrana deben su nombre.en: The Redridge Mountains owe their name to their reddish rocks.

Las Profundidades de Roca Negra son una.en: Blackrock Depths is an entire dwarven city under the mountain: the Dark Iron capital.

Las Rocas Rojas de Mulgore son un lugar.en: Mulgore's Red Rocks are a sacred place: the tauren ancestors rest there.

Las Rocas Rojas son el lugar más sagrado.en: The Red Rocks are Mulgore's most sacred place: your people's ancestors rest there.

Las Tierras de la Peste del Este siguen.en: The Eastern Plaguelands stay sad even by day. The Scourge never rests here.

Las aguas de nivel 20 a 35. El rango Exp.en: Level 20 to 35 waters. Expert is learned from the book the Booty Bay fisherman sells.

Las barras y retratos vuelven al termina.en: Bars and portraits come back once combat ends.

Las bendiciones mayores duran más y cubr.en: Greater blessings last longer and cover an entire class in the group. They save a lot of mana!

Las bolsas de Alfa acomodan todo por cat.en: Alfa's bags sort everything by category, mark new and quest items, and deposit to the bank quickly.

Las bolsas que coses siempre se venden:.en: The bags you sew always sell: everyone wants more space.

Las bombas y granadas te salvan en mazmo.en: Bombs and grenades save you in dungeons and in fights against the other faction.

Las cajas cerradas las abren los pícaros.en: Locked boxes are opened by rogues; offer them in chat and sometimes they'll even do it for free.

Las cartas de la Luna Negra caen de enem.en: Darkmoon cards drop from enemies all over the world; a complete deck is traded at the Faire for a powerful trinket.

Las casas de subastas neutrales de Bahía.en: The neutral auction houses in Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook take a bigger cut, but let you trade with the other faction.

Las centinelas de Vallefresno pelean sin.en: Ashenvale's sentinels fight tirelessly against the Warsong orc loggers.

Las centinelas domestican sables de hiel.en: The sentinels tame frostsabers in Winterspring and trust them only to those who earn their respect.

Las citas de la manada en los próximos s.en: The pack's meetups for the next seven days. Propose one above, in "Pack outings".

Las citas de la manada están apagadas (A.en: Pack outings are off (La Jauría settings).

Las citas de los próximos siete días, ac.en: The meetups of the next seven days, laid out by day.

Las citas van a los lobos de tu hermanda.en: Outings go to the wolves in your guild: you need one.

Las criaturas que invocan los enemigos p.en: Creatures enemies summon for a while.

Las cuentas de prueba no pueden comparti.en: Trial accounts cannot share: the game does not allow it.

Las de tu ruta que tienes cerca.en: The ones on your route nearby

Las de tu ruta, las de la guía o todas:.en: Your route's, the guide's or all of them: chosen in Settings > Questing, with everything else about quests.

Las direcciones (http, www, discord.gg).en: Addresses (http, www, discord.gg) become a link: one click opens a box to copy it. Hovering a chat window shows a button that copies its last lines (also /alfa copiar). Nothing is sent.

Las dos se suben solas mientras matas y.en: Both level up on their own while you kill and travel, and what you gather sells well: gold for your mount and your abilities.

Las dríades son hijas de Cenarius, y los.en: Dryads are Cenarius's daughters, and the Keepers of the Grove are his sons.

Las especias y el agua las venden los ta.en: Innkeepers and cooking suppliers sell the spices and the water. Fishing gives you a lot of what you cook.

Las esquinas de la pantalla se oscurecen.en: The screen corners darken gradually, like in a photo.

Las excavaciones de los enanos despertar.en: The dwarves' excavations woke up the troggs, and now Thelsamar has to watch out for them.

Las flores cantoras corrompidas de Frond.en: Felwood's corrupted songflowers can be cleansed; doing so grants you a blessing that lasts a good while.

Las fronteras entre zonas ya no parpadea.en: Borders between zones no longer flicker when you move the map.

Las gafas de ingeniero solo las pueden u.en: Engineering goggles can only be worn by engineers: wear them proudly!

Las guías del motor están apagadas en Aj.en: Engine guides are turned off in Settings.

Las guías y mazmorras de tu nivel al 60,.en: The guides and dungeons from your level to 60, and how much you move up each day.

Las guías y planes que sigues, a un clic.en: The guides and plans you follow, one click away.

Las hierbas de nivel alto se venden muy.en: High-level herbs sell very well at the auction house.

Las líneas que escribe Anunciar en el ch.en: The lines Announce writes in your group or raid chat.

Las marcas de la manada también en el mi.en: The pack's marks on the minimap too, not only on the world map.

Las marcas en el suelo de hechizos y áre.en: Ground markings of spells and areas. Turning them off hides combat warnings: better keep them on.

Las mejores misiones que ya puedes tomar.en: The best quests you can already take near you, in the shortest order.

Las mesetas de Cima del Trueno están uni.en: Thunder Bluff's mesas are linked by bridges, and you ride elevators up to the city.

Las metas se cumplen solas al hacerlas;.en: Goals are met by themselves when you do them; notes you mark yourself. Order them as you like.

Las misiones de Molino Tarren mandan a l.en: Tarren Mill's quests send the Horde against the human farms of the foothills.

Las misiones grises dan poca XP. Entréga.en: Gray quests give little XP. Turn them in and move on.

Las misiones previas y el nivel que pide.en: The earlier quests and the level it needs, so you can take it.

Las misiones que más experiencia dan cer.en: The quests near you that give the most experience.

Las misiones repetibles de reputación, c.en: Repeatable reputation quests, like turning in cloth, are also a way of farming.

Las monturas de los gnomos son mecazancu.en: Gnome mounts are mechanostriders, mechanical birds they invented themselves.

Las monturas de otra raza de tu bando pu.en: Mounts of another race of your faction may require reputation with its city: your own race's always work.

Las monturas se consiguen fuera de las g.en: Mounts are obtained outside of guides: check it in the Encyclopedia.

Las monturas épicas del Clásico cuestan.en: Classic's epic mounts cost quite a bit of gold; saving it little by little is part of the adventure.

Las notas del lobo están apagadas (Ajust.en: Wolf notes are off (La Jauría settings).

Las ondas al caminar o nadar en el agua..en: Ripples when walking or swimming in water.

Las pestañas toman la letra y los colore.en: The tabs take the style's font and colours; the selected one gets the accent line. In Classic WoW the game's own tabs stay.

Las piedras de afilar y los contrapesos.en: The sharpening stones and weightstones you make help warriors and rogues: they always find buyers.

Las piedras de salud que creas le salvan.en: The healthstones you create save your whole group's lives.

Las pociones de vida y maná siempre se v.en: Health and mana potions always sell: every dungeon needs them.

Las primeras misiones de un humano en Vi.en: A human's first quests in Northshire are about kobolds, Defias bandits... and wolves. Not all of us are nice, you know?

Las profesiones de fabricación dan retos.en: Crafting professions give Legacy challenges at 150, 225 and 300.

Las profesiones de recolección dan oro d.en: Gathering professions make gold from level 1. Herbs or mining!

Las que Lya ya te dijo sus tres veces. C.en: The ones Lya has already said three times. "Show them again" brings them back.

Las que se hacen una sola vez..en: The ones you do only once.

Las que se repiten cada día..en: The ones that repeat every day.

Las que se repiten cada semana..en: The ones that repeat every week.

Las que vienen después, más pequeñas a l.en: The ones that come next, smaller, to the right.

Las que ya no te dan casi nada y no abre.en: The ones that give you almost nothing and don't open another worth it. On the Route page, "Grey quests": each one with its "Abandon".

Las que ya usaste y tardan en volver. Ap.en: The ones you've used that take a while to come back. Turn off the ones you don't want on the bar.

Las ranuras que tu tecla nunca cambia: c.en: The slots your key never changes: head, hands, feet, trinkets and the rest.

Las recetas se compran a vendedores de c.en: Recipes are bought from food vendors and some drop from enemies.

Las ruinas de Eldarath fueron una ciudad.en: The Ruins of Eldarath were once an elven city; today they're full of naga.

Las rutas y los planes que armas en la p.en: The routes and plans you build on Alfa's Route page.

Las sacerdotisas de Elune guían a tu pue.en: Elune's priestesses guide your people, and Tyrande rules them from the Temple of the Moon.

Las sesiones, las zonas y los objetos de.en: This character's sessions, zones and items.

Las vendas suben de lino a lana, seda, t.en: Bandages go up from linen to wool, silk, mageweave and runecloth.

Las ventanas de chat, sus pestañas y la.en: The chat windows, their tabs and the edit box take the style you choose below and change with it. Turning it off brings back the usual chat, without a /reload.

Le baja la armadura al enemigo y genera.en: Lowers the enemy's armor and makes lots of threat. The tank's bread and butter.

Le baja la armadura al enemigo y no lo d.en: Lowers the enemy's armor and keeps it from going invisible.

Le das mucho maná a un aliado. Dáselo a.en: Gives an ally lots of mana. Give it to your healer or use it on yourself.

Le dijiste a %s que esta vez no puedes..en: You told %s you can't make it this time.

Le disparas a varios enemigos a la vez..en: Shoots several enemies at once. Careful not to wake the sleeping ones.

Le pediste a %s que te las comparta..en: You asked %s to share them with you.

Le pregunté a la manada de tu zona. Si a.en: I asked the pack in your zone. If someone opens their den on another layer, I'll let you know.

Le propusiste a %s ser su mentor. Te avi.en: You offered to be %s's mentor. I'll tell you when they answer.

Le quita magia buena al enemigo..en: Strips helpful magic from the enemy.

Le robas vida al enemigo y te curas. Ide.en: Steals health from the enemy to heal you. Great when you're solo.

Lee el precio más bajo de cada objeto en.en: Reads the lowest price of every item in the whole auction house. It buys and posts nothing. It can be used every 15 minutes.

Lee los objetivos de la misión antes de.en: Read the quest objectives before heading out: you'll save trips.

Leeroy Jenkins se hizo famoso por lanzar.en: Leeroy Jenkins became famous for charging alone, shouting his own name, into a room full of whelps in Blackrock Spire.

Letras grandes en el centro de la pantal.en: Big letters in the middle of the screen when the boss does something important.

Libera tu sello en el enemigo: daño extr.en: Unleash your seal on the enemy: extra damage.

Libera tu sello sobre el enemigo para un.en: Unleashes your seal on the enemy for an extra effect. Seal, judge, then seal again.

Libra a un aliado de raíces y de lentitu.en: Frees an ally from roots and slows.

Limpien a sus ayudantes antes de empezar.en: Clear his helpers before you start on him.

Listo, ya no te lo digo. Si me extrañas,.en: Done, I won't tell you anymore. If you miss it, it's on my page: "Tips you muted".

Listo: %d habilidades nuevas en tu barra.en: Done: %d new abilities on your %s bar.

Listo: %s para %s. Revisa la carta y pul.en: Done: %s for %s. Check the letter and press «Send».

Listo: 1 habilidad nueva en tu barra de.en: Done: 1 new ability on your %s bar.

Listo: Alfa soltó la memoria que ya no o.en: Done: Alfa freed the memory it no longer needed.

Listo: copié %d atajo de Blizzard a tu m.en: Done: copied %d Blizzard shortcut to your Alfa map.

Listo: copié %d atajos de Blizzard a tu.en: Done: copied %d Blizzard shortcuts to your Alfa map.

Listo: te abrimos un susurro para %s. Re.en: Done: we opened a whisper to %s. Check the message and press Enter.

Listo: tu mapa también funciona en los m.en: Done: your map also works on Blizzard's frames.

Llama a la manada cuando necesites ayuda.en: Call the pack when you need help; the wolves in your zone come with "On my way!". And "Follow" no longer lets go when you catch up.

Llama a tu mascota a tu lado..en: Calls your pet to your side.

Llama a varios lobos al empezar: usen at.en: He calls several wolves at the start: use area attacks or kill the wolves first.

Llega Lya, una loba compañera que guarda.en: Meet Lya, a companion she-wolf who keeps the story of every quest and tells you facts about each zone.

Llega a la maestría Diestro con una capt.en: Reach Skilled mastery with a catch.

Llega con %d punto del legado ganado en.en: Comes with %d legacy point earned on your account.

Llega con %d puntos del legado ganados e.en: Reach %d Legacy points earned on your account.

Llega con ayudantes naga: mátenlos prime.en: She comes with naga helpers: kill them first.

Llega con guardias: tírenlos aparte si p.en: He comes with guards: pull them away from him if you can.

Llega con lobos: elimínenlos primero..en: He comes with wolves: kill them first.

Llega con su perro: una persona debe tan.en: He brings his dog: one person tanks each, or kill the dog first.

Llegas al rival con ira para pegar de in.en: You reach your opponent with rage to hit right away.

Llegas en unos %d min.en: You get there in about %d min

Llegaste al final; quedaron %d pasos sin.en: You reached the end; %d steps were left undone.

Llegaste al final; quedó %d paso sin hac.en: You reached the end; %d step was left undone.

Llegaste al límite del juego (%d instanc.en: You've hit the game's limit (%d instances per hour): you can enter another in %d min.

Llegaste al tope de %s: aprende %s con u.en: You reached the %s cap: learn %s from a trainer to keep going up.

Llegaste con %s. La flecha te sigue llev.en: You reached %s. The arrow keeps leading you while they move; to drop the trail, "Stop following".

Lleva al máximo la distancia de la cámar.en: Sets the camera distance (the one in Options > Controls) to its maximum. Turning it off brings yours back.

Lleva siempre un sello puesto aunque est.en: Always keep a seal up even while healing.

Lleva siempre vendas y comida: descansar.en: Always carry bandages and food: resting a little and safely is faster than dying.

Llevamos %d páginas en tu historia. La m.en: Your story has %d pages. The newest: %s.

Llevamos un buen rato cazando… ¿no traer.en: We've been hunting for a good while… you wouldn't happen to have a little sausage for your wolf?

Llevas %s ahora. Solo oro entero (10 = 1.en: You carry %s now. Whole gold only (10 = 10 gold).

Llevas %s aquí; tu récord es %s..en: You've been here %s; your record is %s.

Llevas %s jugando. Estírate, toma agua y.en: You've been playing for %s. Stretch, drink some water and come back stronger.

Llevas %s. La manada te espera aunque te.en: It's been %s. The pack will wait for you if you take a breather.

Llevas %s. Si cierras sesión en una posa.en: It's been %s. If you log out at an inn, you earn rested XP.

Llévame a la subasta.en: Take me to the auction house

Llévame a lo que falta.en: Take me to what is missing

Llévame a una zona de tu nivel.en: Take me to a zone for my level

Llévame a... (el camino a cualquier luga.en: Take me to... (the way to any place)

Lo acompañan otros lanzadores: interrúmp.en: Other casters come with him: interrupt them.

Lo apagas o lo enciendes cuando quieras.en: Turn it off or on any time in Pack > La Jauría.

Lo aprendes con %s. Tu tope sube a %d..en: You learn it at %s. Your cap goes up to %d.

Lo bueno en azul, los avisos en amarillo.en: Good things in blue, warnings in yellow and danger in orange, and debuffs in colours you can tell apart without red and green.

Lo cambias cuando quieras en Ajustes > E.en: Change it whenever you like in Settings > Style and sound.

Lo cazaron %s. Ve a ver si ya salió..en: Killed %s. Go see if it's up.

Lo de %s y %s tiene su historia. ¿Te la.en: The thing with %s and %s has a story. Want to hear it?

Lo de Alfa en la barra de experiencia.en: Alfa's info on the experience bar

Lo de Alfa en la barra de reputación.en: Alfa's info on the reputation bar

Lo enseña un instructor de la profesión.en: Taught by a trainer of the profession

Lo gris véndelo a los vendedores, no en.en: Sell gray items to vendors, not at auction: nobody will buy them there.

Lo gris y lo que marcaste como chatarra..en: Grey items and what you marked as junk. Never what you marked to keep or what a quest needs.

Lo justo para abrir la siguiente fila..en: Just enough to open the next row.

Lo mejor de los dos lados. Si no sabes c.en: The best of both sides. If you don't know which to pick, pick this one.

Lo menos que espera Lya entre un consejo.en: The least Lya waits between one tip and the next. Important things don't wait.

Lo menos que espera Lya entre una histor.en: The least Lya waits between one story and the next. Never in combat or dungeons.

Lo más gastado va al %d %%. Te llevo con.en: Your most worn piece is at %d %%. I'll take you to someone who repairs.

Lo más ligero: para equipos modestos o p.en: The lightest: for modest PCs or to raise FPS in big fights.

Lo más nuevo va arriba..en: The newest is at the top.

Lo más útil para este momento, en grande.en: The most useful thing for right now, big: your next step, what's urgent and your path a couple of clicks away.

Lo nuevo de esta versión, en pocas palab.en: What this version brings, in a few words.

Lo olimos, lo seguimos y cayó. ¡Así caza.en: We sniffed it, tracked it and it fell. That's how the pack hunts!

Lo pequeño que hace el juego más cómodo:.en: The small things that make the game more comfortable: quests, flights, minimap, chat and bars in Alfa's style, frames, tooltip, dressing room, camera and sounds.

Lo pide una misión de %s..en: A quest of %s asks for it.

Lo pones al empezar a pelear..en: You put it on as the fight starts.

Lo primero que puedes soltar: %s (%s)..en: The first thing you can let go: %s (%s).

Lo que Alfa acepta, rechaza o comparte s.en: What Alfa accepts, declines or shares by itself. Hold Shift to decide yourself at that moment.

Lo que Alfa te dijo mientras no veías.en: What Alfa told you while you weren't looking

Lo que Alfa te dijo, con su hora.en: What Alfa told you, with its time

Lo que Alfa te dijo, con su hora, y lo q.en: What Alfa told you, with its time, and what left before you saw it. Also with the bell in the Alfa window or /alfa avisos.

Lo que Lya sabe de aquí.en: What Lya knows about this place

Lo que buscas en la Enciclopedia.en: What you look up in the Encyclopedia

Lo que cazas da el doble de experiencia.en: What you hunt gives double experience until your rest runs out. It fills up at an inn or in a city.

Lo que choca con Alfa y cómo arreglarlo.en: What clashes with Alfa and how to fix it

Lo que comparte alguien de tu grupo con.en: What someone in your group shares with Alfa lands in your markers, with their name, and lets you know so you can follow it.

Lo que cuentan las misiones que vas toma.en: What the quests you take have to say

Lo que dan los bancos de peces de aquí y.en: What the fish schools here give that isn't in your journal yet. Click: the guide with the nearby schools.

Lo que el menú del juego no enseña, a tu.en: What the game menu doesn't show, your way

Lo que elegiste al configurarlo: aceptar.en: Whatever you chose when setting it up: accepting and turning in quests, selling grey items, repairing, taking flights... Change it whenever you like.

Lo que encuentras en la manada.en: What you'll find in the pack

Lo que este personaje lleva en las mazmo.en: What this character has done in dungeons: saved by itself as you defeat bosses and pick up loot.

Lo que ganaste la última vez que jugaste.en: What you gained the last time you played this character.

Lo que más conviene ahora.en: What pays off most right now

Lo que más rinde cerca de ti.en: What pays off most near you

Lo que no está a la vista no sale aquí..en: Anything not on screen won't show here.

Lo que quieras contarle al desarrollador.en: Whatever you'd like to tell Alfa's developer.

Lo que quieras; la marcas tú cuando la h.en: Anything you like; you mark it when you do it.

Lo que se queda la subasta de cada venta.en: What the auction house keeps from each sale. Usually 5% at your faction's and 15% at the neutral one. It is an estimate.

Lo que sigue en tu build no está en tu á.en: What comes next in your build isn't in your tree

Lo que sigue en tu plan no está en tu ár.en: What comes next in your build isn't in your tree

Lo que sigue pide este nivel: hasta ento.en: What comes next needs this level: until then, the guide does not send you there.

Lo que te falta para una mazmorra, en un.en: What you're missing for a dungeon, in a notice. Also with /alfa listo.

Lo que te pasa a ti: curación recibida,.en: What happens to you: healing received, dodges, resources. May need /reload the first time.

Lo que tenía ya está hecho, omitido o fu.en: What it had is done, skipped or no longer in your log. Build it again with the quests you have now.

Lo que tiene cada uno de tus personajes.en: What each of your characters has, and this session's gold.

Lo que trae esta versión, contado corto..en: What this version brings, told short. Look at it whenever you like.

Lo que trajo la última versión de Alfa,.en: What the latest Alfa version brought, in short.

Lo que tu build necesita de tu equipo y.en: What your build needs from your gear and where to get it.

Lo que tu clase se pone antes de pelear.en: What your class puts on before a fight is active.

Lo que tu plan necesita de tu equipo y d.en: What your build needs from your gear and where to get it.

Lo que tu profesión de recolección junta.en: What your gathering profession collects best.

Lo que ya tienes en el banco.en: What you already have in the bank

Lo revisa el desarrollador de Alfa. En e.en: Alfa's developer reads it. Nobody else in that channel sees your message. If you're not on the Discord yet, join with the invite above.

Lo sigues: el rastreador te muestra la m.en: You follow it: the tracker shows the current goal and the arrow goes to each place.

Lo suma a tu lista de compras de Comerci.en: Adds it to your Trade shopping list, with what its recipe needs.

Lord Kazzak, un demonio enorme, ronda la.en: Lord Kazzak, a huge demon, roams the Blasted Lands; in Classic he's a world boss for raids.

Lord Xavius, el consejero de Azshara, co.en: Lord Xavius, Azshara's advisor, convinced the Highborne to open the way for Sargeras. When he died, Sargeras brought him back as the first satyr.

Los Altonato eran la nobleza élfica que.en: The Highborne were the elven nobility who lived for the Well's magic. Their queen, Azshara, was so beautiful that her people worshipped her.

Los Amani pelearon contra los altos elfo.en: The Amani fought the high elves for thousands of years. Their capital, Zul'Aman, lies in the forests near Quel'Thalas.

Los Barbabronce ganaron la Guerra de los.en: The Bronzebeards won the War of the Three Hammers, and that's why Ironforge is theirs.

Los Claros de Tirisfal guardan las ruina.en: Tirisfal Glades holds the ruins of Lordaeron, Arthas's kingdom. Beneath its old capital, the Forsaken built the Undercity.

Los Defias usan cosechadores mecánicos q.en: The Defias use mechanical harvesters that work the fields on their own... and they don't like visitors.

Los Furiarena de Zul'Farrak son trols de.en: The Sandfury of Zul'Farrak are desert trolls, distant cousins of the Darkspear.

Los Gurubashi llamaron a Hakkar, el Deso.en: The Gurubashi summoned Hakkar, the Soulflayer. When they saw what he did, the other tribes joined forces to cast him out.

Los Hierro Negro invocaron a Ragnaros si.en: The Dark Iron dwarves summoned Ragnaros by accident at the end of the War of the Three Hammers, and have been his slaves ever since.

Los Hierro Negro también excavan en Ulda.en: The Dark Iron dwarves also dig in Uldaman, looking for the same thing as the dwarves of Ironforge.

Los Lanza Negra suelen terminar sus fras.en: The Darkspear often end their sentences with a «mon». It's catchy, mon!

Los PNJ dejan de hablar al saludarte o a.en: NPCs stop talking when they greet you or give you quests. It also mutes error speech.

Los Perdidos del pantano son draenei que.en: The swamp's Lost Ones are draenei who came from Draenor and were changed forever.

Los Páramos de Poniente eran el granero.en: Westfall was Stormwind's breadbasket; today many of its farms are in the hands of the Defias Brotherhood.

Los Renegados aguantan bajo el agua much.en: The Forsaken can stay underwater far longer than the living. They don't need to breathe that much!

Los Renegados entraron a la Horda gracia.en: The Forsaken joined the Horde thanks to the tauren, who hoped to find them a cure. Many orcs still don't trust them.

Los Renegados hicieron de Rémol, un viej.en: The Forsaken made Brill, an old human town, their first stop in Tirisfal.

Los Renegados nuevos despiertan en Campo.en: New Forsaken wake in Deathknell, in Tirisfal, as undead freed from the Lich King.

Los Renegados pueden comerse cadáveres p.en: The Forsaken can feed on corpses to recover health. I'd rather have sausages, thanks.

Los Renegados recuerdan quiénes fueron e.en: The Forsaken remember who they were in life, and that weighs more than any wound.

Los Renegados son no-muertos que recuper.en: The Forsaken are undead who regained their free will when the Lich King's power weakened.

Los Tótem Siniestro son tauren que no qu.en: The Grimtotem are tauren who don't like the Horde; their leader Magatha lives right in Thunder Bluff.

Los ajustes de los recordatorios están e.en: The reminder settings are in the Alfa window's search.

Los altos elfos pelearon con la Alianza.en: The high elves fought with the Alliance in the Second War because of an old blood debt to Thoradin's line.

Los altos elfos que sobrevivieron a la P.en: The high elves who survived the Scourge began calling themselves blood elves, in honor of their fallen. Kael'thas leads them.

Los antídotos que haces curan venenos. ¡.en: The anti-venoms you make cure poisons. With Ashenvale's spiders, they're welcome!

Los anuncios esperan a que el juego term.en: Announcements wait for the game to finish writing the zone, and Alfa's button always stays in view on the minimap.
