Los aqir eran un imperio antiguo de inse.en: The aqir were an ancient insect empire that fought the trolls. From them came the qiraji of Ahn'Qiraj and the nerubians of the north.

Los avisos de viaje hablan como la manad.en: Travel alerts speak like the pack: "The pack travels", the wolf in the ring and a paw print that walks while your boat arrives.

Los avisos hacen fila y no se enciman; l.en: Notices wait their turn and never overlap; what you didn't see stays in the bell, with filters by type.

Los avisos pequeños de Alfa los dice Lya.en: Alfa's small alerts are said by Lya in her bubble, with their button, instead of popping up at the top. If she's hidden or you're in combat, they show as usual.

Los avisos que se fueron sin que los vie.en: Notices that left before you saw them, with their time. Also with /alfa perdi.

Los botones de otros addons alrededor de.en: Other addons' buttons around the minimap only show while the pointer is over it. Alfa's always stays in view.

Los cebos suben tu habilidad de pesca un.en: Lures raise your fishing skill for a while: use them in tough waters.

Los cementerios del Ocaso están llenos d.en: Duskwood's graveyards are full of undead raised by necromancers hiding in the forest.

Los centauros dicen descender de Zaetar,.en: The centaurs claim descent from Zaetar, son of the demigod Cenarius, and Theradras, the earth princess. Their clans fight each other almost as much as everyone else.

Los cinco Aspectos Dragón recibieron su.en: The five Dragon Aspects received their power from the titans: Alexstrasza life, Ysera dreams, Nozdormu time, Malygos magic and Neltharion the earth.

Los clanes Gelkis y Magram de Desolace p.en: Desolace's Gelkis and Magram clans fight each other, and both look for allies among adventurers.

Los clanes orcos tienen historias distin.en: Orc clans have very different stories: Frostwolf, Warsong, Blackrock, Dragonmaw... each with its own pride.

Los cruzados escarlata vienen en grupos.en: Scarlet crusaders come in groups and some heal: interrupt the healers.

Los críticos hacen el doble de daño y al.en: Crits deal double damage, and give warriors more rage.

Los cuatro dragones verdes de la pesadil.en: The four green dragons of the nightmare, Ysondre, Lethon, Emeriss and Taerar, appear by the great trees of the Dream.

Los cuatro señores elementales son Ragna.en: The four elemental lords are Ragnaros of fire, Al'Akir of air, Therazane of earth and Neptulon of water.

Los cultistas del Martillo Crepuscular u.en: Twilight's Hammer cultists use wind stones to summon their lords; wearing their disguise, you can too.

Los datos de Alfa no traen botín propio.en: Alfa's data has no loot of their own for its bosses.

Los datos de la Enciclopedia están apaga.en: The Encyclopedia's data is turned off: in the addon list on the character screen, turn on "Alfa Codex" and log in again.

Los datos de la Enciclopedia no cargaron.en: The Encyclopedia's data didn't load. Check Alfa: I'll tell you what's wrong and how to fix it.

Los datos de las mazmorras se cargan fue.en: Dungeon data loads out of combat. This page fills in by itself when the fight ends.

Los datos del mundo (Codex) no están dis.en: World data (Codex) isn't available: pools, quests and sources are missing.

Los datos del mundo de Alfa están apagad.en: Alfa's world data is turned off: enable "Alfa Codex" in the AddOns list.

Los datos son del medidor oficial del ju.en: The data comes from the game's official meter: you, your group or raid, and their pets.

Los dioses antiguos son seres de antes d.en: The Old Gods are beings older than the titans, imprisoned beneath Azeroth's soil. C'Thun and Yogg-Saron whisper to anyone who'll listen.

Los dioses antiguos susurran en la mente.en: The Old Gods whisper in mortal minds; many cults, like the Twilight's Hammer, were born from listening to them.

Los dracoleones son las monturas volador.en: Wind riders are the Horde's flying mounts; gryphons, the Alliance's; and hippogryphs, the night elves'.

Los dracónidos negros rondan la entrada.en: Black dragonspawn prowl the entrance to Onyxia's lair, in the south of the marsh.

Los dracónidos son los soldados de los d.en: Dragonspawn are the dragons' soldiers; the black ones serve Nefarian in Blackrock Mountain.

Los draenei huyeron de su mundo, Argus,.en: The draenei fled their world, Argus, with the prophet Velen. Their name means «the exiled ones».

Los dragones cromáticos, con escamas de.en: Chromatic dragons, with scales of every color, are Nefarian's experiments. His most feared creation is Chromaggus.

Los dragones negros se disfrazan de huma.en: Black dragons disguise themselves as humans to deceive: Onyxia is Lady Katrana Prestor in Stormwind, and Nefarian calls himself Lord Victor Nefarius.

Los dragones verdes siguen vigilando el.en: The green dragons still watch over the sunken temple so no one calls Hakkar again.

Los elementales de fuego de La Garganta.en: The fire elementals of the Searing Gorge and Un'Goro Crater drop fire materials that many professions need.

Los elementales de fuego y las arañas de.en: Fire elementals and lava spiders are the usual neighbors in the Searing Gorge.

Los elfos de la noche fueron inmortales.en: The night elves were immortal thanks to Nordrassil, until they sacrificed it to defeat Archimonde at Mount Hyjal.

Los elfos de la noche montan sables, gra.en: Night elves ride sabers, great cats. Not to brag, but a wolf is friendlier.

Los elfos de la noche nuevos empiezan en.en: New night elves start in Shadowglen, on Teldrassil, among spiders and wisps.

Los elfos de la noche pueden fundirse co.en: Night elves can melt into the shadows when they stand still.

Los elfos de la noche se unieron a la Al.en: The night elves joined the Alliance after the Third War.

Los enanos Hierro Negro tomaron Dun Modr.en: The Dark Iron dwarves took Dun Modr, north of the Wetlands, and harass anyone crossing the bridge.

Los enanos creen descender de los terrán.en: Dwarves believe they descend from the titans' stone earthen, and that's why the Explorers' League never stops digging.

Los enanos de Forjaz pelean contra los H.en: Ironforge's dwarves fight the Dark Irons in the Wetlands and the Badlands.

Los enanos nuevos empiezan en un valle h.en: New dwarves start in an icy valley of Dun Morogh, fighting ice trolls and troggs.

Los encantadores también hacen varitas:.en: Enchanters also make wands: mages, priests and warlocks will thank you.

Los enemigos cercanos pegan menos. Muy ú.en: Nearby enemies hit softer. Very useful when you tank several.

Los enemigos de tus misiones marcados so.en: Your quest enemies marked on their nameplates and quest items glowing in your bags.

Los enemigos lanzan radiación y veneno:.en: Enemies use radiation and poison: bring health potions.

Los enemigos más débiles, que el juego m.en: The weakest enemies, which the game marks with a minus sign.

Los errores de Alfa que se atraparon, pa.en: The Alfa errors that were caught, to copy into your report.

Los espíritus de las elfas caídas que la.en: The spirits of fallen elven women enslaved by the Scourge become banshees. Sylvanas is the most famous of them all.

Los fragmentos de alma se ganan drenando.en: Soul shards are earned by draining the enemy's soul right as it dies.

Los frascos del Clásico duran dos horas.en: Classic flasks last two hours and persist through death: that's why raids ask for them so much.

Los frascos los venden los proveedores d.en: Alchemy suppliers sell the vials. Herbalism is its best partner: you gather the herbs.

Los frascos más poderosos llevan Loto ne.en: The most powerful flasks need Black Lotus, the rarest herb in Azeroth.

Los fuegos artificiales también son inge.en: Fireworks are engineering too. One to celebrate every level!

Los fuegos fatuos son espíritus de elfos.en: Wisps are the spirits of night elves who keep watching over the forest after death.

Los furbolgs Fauces de Madera son de los.en: The Timbermaw furbolgs are among the few who haven't been corrupted; their tunnels lead to Winterspring and Moonglade.

Los furbolgs de Costa Oscura se están co.en: Darkshore's furbolgs are being corrupted, and the elves of Auberdine aren't quite sure why.

Los furbolgs eran un pueblo pacífico de.en: The furbolgs were a peaceful bear-people, but demonic corruption drove many of their tribes mad.

Los geomantes lanzan fuego y ponen tótem.en: Geomancers cast fire and drop totems: interrupt them and break the totems.

Los gnomos empiezan con los enanos en Du.en: Gnomes start alongside the dwarves in Dun Morogh: Gnomeregan is lost and your people live as refugees in Ironforge.

Los gnomos inventaron el Tranvía Subterr.en: Gnomes built the Deeprun Tram that links Ironforge with Stormwind.

Los gnomos que se quedaron en Gnomeregan.en: The gnomes who stayed in Gnomeregan were harmed by the radiation; some lost their minds.

Los goblins de la fundición tienen ayuda.en: The goblins in the foundry have helpers nearby: look around before you attack.

Los goblins vienen de la isla de Kezan,.en: Goblins come from the isle of Kezan, and their great city is Undermine. They're more loyal to gold than to any faction.

Los grandes árboles que hablan en Darnas.en: The great talking trees in Darnassus and Ashenvale are Ancients, guardians of the forest.

Los grifos (o dragones) a los lados de l.en: The gryphons (or wyverns) at the sides of the main bar.
The gryphons (or wyverns) on the sides of the main bar. "In the style's color" needs the bars style; "Hidden" always works.

Los gules, las abominaciones y las gárgo.en: Ghouls, abominations and gargoyles are the Scourge's most common soldiers. Abominations are stitched together from many corpses.

Los herreros hacen llaves que abren cofr.en: Blacksmiths make keys that open chests and locked boxes. Useful and fun!

Los humanos fueron los primeros en apren.en: Humans were the first to learn magic from the high elves, back in the Troll Wars.

Los infernales son demonios que la Legió.en: Infernals are demons the Legion hurls down from the sky like meteors.

Los ingenieros pueden fabricar mascotas.en: Engineers can build mechanical pets, like a squirrel.

Los instructores y vendedores de pesca s.en: Fishing trainers and vendors show on the map and minimap.

Los jefes opcionales y raros se descubre.en: Optional and rare bosses are revealed when you finish the dungeon.

Los jefes se descubren al vencerlos: su.en: Bosses are revealed as you defeat them: their name and loot stay hidden until then. Their tips can always be shown.

Los kits de armadura que haces le sirven.en: The armor kits you make are useful to everyone: there's always someone to buy them.

Los kodos son los compañeros de viaje de.en: Kodos are the tauren's traveling companions, and their graveyard is in Desolace.

Los kóbolds de las minas de Elwynn cuida.en: The kobolds in Elwynn's mines guard their candles like treasure: underground, light is everything.

Los lobos aprenden Aullido furioso, que.en: Wolves learn Furious Howl, which boosts your group's damage. See? Wolves are the best!

Los lobos de tu zona saben dónde estás..en: The wolves in your zone know where you are. I'll tell you who's coming.

Los lobos que se dejan ver en el mapa. U.en: The wolves who let themselves be seen on the map. Click their mark and the arrow takes you.

Los lobos que usan Alfa y se dejan ver e.en: The wolves who use Alfa and let themselves be seen on the map, and your group, who you see now.

Los logros de la manada: se ganan pescan.en: The pack's achievements: earned by fishing, cooking what you catch and exploring new waters. Each one is announced only once.

Los lugares que pides ver en el mapa des.en: The places you ask to see on the map from the Encyclopedia.

Los maestros de vuelo de tu facción y lo.en: Flight masters of your faction and neutral ones: green when known, amber with "?" when you still have to discover them. Click: follow it with the arrow.

Los maestros de vuelo de tu zona que tod.en: The flight masters in your zone you don't know yet, highlighted. Click: the arrow takes you there.

Los magos de Dalaran forman el Kirin Tor.en: The mages of Dalaran form the Kirin Tor, their council of the wise.

Los marcos se mueven fuera de combate..en: Frames can be moved out of combat.

Los marcos, fondos, botones y letras del.en: The game's own frames, backgrounds, buttons and fonts, with gold titles.

Los mismos marcadores de misiones en el.en: The same quest markers on the minimap.

Los múrlocs hablan con gorgoteos y burbu.en: Murlocs speak in gurgles and bubbles: that «mrglglgl» is their actual language.

Los nagas y sátiros lanzan escarcha y ra.en: Nagas and satyrs cast frost and lightning: interrupt the casters first.

Los nerubianos, arañas gigantes de Rasga.en: The nerubians, giant spiders of Northrend, fought the Lich King and lost; many serve him now.

Los no-muertos de la Plaga no sienten mi.en: The Scourge's undead feel neither fear nor fatigue, and that's why they're so hard to stop.

Los nodos de la zona que miras, con su n.en: The nodes of the zone you are looking at; hover one for its name, level and how often you gathered it. Click one: the arrow takes you there.

Los nodos que se pisarían en pantalla va.en: Nodes that would overlap on screen share one pin with their count. Zoom in and they split.

Los nodos que tienes cerca. El punto del.en: The nodes near you. The game's tracking dot tells whether something is there now.

Los nodos que trae Alfa. Sin esto solo v.en: The nodes Alfa ships with. Without it you only see the ones you found.

Los números de lo que curas encima de qu.en: Your healing numbers above whoever receives it.

Los números de tu daño encima de quien g.en: Your damage numbers above whoever you hit.

Los números son orientativos: cada recet.en: The numbers are a guide: each recipe gives points by its color (orange always, yellow almost always, green sometimes).

Los oasis de Los Baldíos se están secand.en: The Barrens' oases are drying up and filling with strange beasts: the Druids of the Fang, who came out of the Wailing Caverns, are corrupting them.

Los objetos se juntan al final de tus bo.en: Items gather at the end of your bags instead of the start.

Los orcos Faucedraco siguen en Los Humed.en: The Dragonmaw orcs are still in the Wetlands, though they no longer have the Dragonqueen.

Los orcos Roca Negra de Rend se adueñaro.en: Rend's Blackrock orcs took over the mountain's summit and call it home.

Los orcos Roca Negra ocupan una vieja fo.en: Blackrock orcs hold an old human fortress east of the mountains.

Los orcos llegaron de Draenor corrompido.en: The orcs came from Draenor corrupted by Mannoroth's blood. Thrall freed them from the internment camps and founded the new Horde.

Los orcos nuevos empiezan en el Valle de.en: New orcs start in the Valley of Trials, in Durotar, where they prove their worth.

Los orcos vienen de Draenor, un mundo qu.en: The orcs come from Draenor, a world that is broken today and called Outland.

Los otros %d puntos del plan llegan con.en: The plan's other %d points come with your next levels.

Los peleteros hacen carcajes y bolsas de.en: Leatherworkers make quivers and ammo pouches for hunters.

Los polvos y las esencias salen de desen.en: Dusts and essences come from disenchanting green or better gear. Every so often your trainer asks for a new runed rod.

Los portales a pie que puedes usar, con.en: The walk-in portals you can use, with where they lead.

Los precios cambian: después de estos dí.en: Prices change: after these many days Alfa reminds you to scan again.

Los primeros caballeros de la muerte los.en: Gul'dan created the first death knights: the bodies of fallen human knights with the souls of orc warlocks.

Los puntos de ruta que ponen otros addon.en: Waypoints other addons set, and /way, point Alfa's arrow. An addon that expects another waypoint addon's settings may not work with this on.

Los puntos de vuelo y de viaje ya se ven.en: Flight points and travel spots now show on the map.

Los puntos que ganas en la cuenta tambié.en: The points you earn on your account also fill the Legacy Reward Track: cosmetic rewards, no gameplay advantage. At Forever's launch they are a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle (toy), the Spectral Bear Cub (pet), the Spectral Bear Tabard and the Reins of the Spectral Bear (mount).

Los puntos que ganas también llenan el r.en: The points you earn also fill the Legacy Reward Track, with cosmetic rewards like the Spectral Bear Cub.

Los recolectaste %d veces en total.en: You gathered them %d times in all

Los recolectaste %d vez en total.en: You gathered them %d time in total

Los rincones de tu zona que todavía no p.en: The corners of your zone you haven't visited yet, with the experience discovering them gives.

Los sacerdotes Atal'ai siguieron adorand.en: The Atal'ai priests kept worshipping Hakkar in secret. They were exiled, and raised their temple in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Los señores del terror, como Mal'Ganis,.en: The dreadlords, like Mal'Ganis, Balnazzar and Varimathras, were the jailers the Legion set over the Lich King.

Los señores elementales servían a los di.en: The elemental lords served the Old Gods. When the titans imprisoned those gods, they banished the elementals to their own planes.

Los spots de farmeo están apagados (Ajus.en: Farming spots are off (La Jauría settings).

Los sumos sacerdotes de Zul'Gurub tomaro.en: The high priests of Zul'Gurub took the power of the animal loa: the bat, the snake, the spider, the panther and the tiger.

Los sátiros de Azshara sueltan tela vil,.en: Azshara's satyrs drop felcloth, much sought after by tailors.

Los talentos confirmados no se quitan gr.en: Confirmed talents can't be removed for free: check the list before accepting.

Los talentos que siguen en el plan no es.en: The plan's next talents aren't in your tree or can't be taken yet. Place them by hand in the game's talent window or pick another build.
The plan's next talents aren't in your tree or can't be taken yet. Place them by hand in the game's talent window or pick another build.

Los tauren Tótem Siniestro tienen campam.en: The Grimtotem tauren have camps in Thousand Needles, and they're not friendly at all.

Los tauren ayudaron a los Renegados a en.en: The tauren helped the Forsaken join the Horde, hoping to find them a cure.

Los tauren de Viento Libre viven en lo a.en: The Freewind tauren live high up in Thousand Needles, safe from the centaurs.
The Freewind tauren live atop the needles, linked by rope bridges, safe from the centaurs below.

Los tauren honran a la Madre Tierra. Dic.en: The tauren honor the Earth Mother. They say the sun and the moon are her eyes: An'she and Mu'sha.

Los tauren llaman An'she al sol y Mu'sha.en: The tauren call the sun An'she and the moon Mu'sha: the eyes of the Earth Mother.

Los tauren nuevos empiezan en el Campame.en: New tauren start at Camp Narache, in Mulgore.

Los tauren vivían como nómadas, acosados.en: The tauren lived as nomads, hounded by the centaurs, until Cairne Bloodhoof allied with Thrall. With the Horde's help they found their home in Mulgore.

Los titanes dejaron guardianes de piedra.en: The titans left guardians of stone and metal on Azeroth. In Uldaman one is still awake: Archaedas.

Los titanes le dieron forma a Azeroth y.en: The titans shaped Azeroth and left guardians and cities, like Uldaman, to look after their work.

Los titanes son seres colosales que reco.en: The titans are colossal beings who roam the cosmos bringing order to worlds. The most famous form the Pantheon, once led by Aman'Thul.

Los titanes usaron este cráter como un j.en: The titans used this crater as a testing garden for life; that's why there are dinosaurs and giant plants.

Los troggs huyen cuando tienen poca vida.en: Troggs flee at low health and bring friends: stop them before they get away.

Los troggs invadieron Gnomeregan, y los.en: The troggs invaded Gnomeregan, and the gnomes flooded their own city with radiation trying to drive them out. It was Mekgineer Thermaplugg's idea.

Los troggs salieron de las profundidades.en: The troggs came out of the depths of Uldaman. Everything suggests they're an ancient titan creation gone wrong.

Los trols Lanza Negra conocieron a Thral.en: The Darkspear trolls met Thrall on the islands where his fleet was wrecked on the way to Kalimdor. Their leader Sen'jin died there, and his son Vol'jin has led them ever since.

Los trols Lanza Negra empiezan con los o.en: Darkspear trolls start with the orcs, in Durotar's Valley of Trials.

Los trols adoran a espíritus llamados lo.en: Trolls worship spirits called loa. Hakkar is one of them, and among the most dangerous.

Los trols de estas tierras descienden de.en: The trolls of these lands descend from the Amani, the ancient forest troll empire. At Jintha'Alor they still raise their altars.

Los vendedores de suministros de pesca t.en: Fishing supplies vendors have poles, nightcrawlers and baubles.

Los worgen son hombres lobo de origen mi.en: The worgen are werewolves of mysterious origin. Arugal brought them to Lordaeron. Don't mix me up with them!

Los zepelines salen de las torres junto.en: Zeppelins leave from the towers next to Orgrimmar for the Undercity and for Grom'gol, in Stranglethorn Vale.

Los árboles del Legado son tres: Profesi.en: There are three Legacy trees: Professions, Adventure and Resourcefulness. At Forever's launch, each character spends up to 16 points.

Los élites y los raros de tu zona que te.en: The elites and rares in your zone that can beat you: in red the ones far above your level. They're gathered when you open Alfa's map.

Los íconos, los nombres y tu flecha se m.en: Icons, names and your arrow move glued to the map when you zoom or drag: they no longer jump a pixel.

Los últimos Altonato de Kalimdor siguen.en: The last Highborne of Kalimdor remain in Dire Maul: they're called the Shen'dralar and they tend their old library.

Lothar cayó ante Orgrim Martillo Maldito.en: Lothar fell to Orgrim Doomhammer at the foot of Blackrock Mountain. Turalyon took his place and won the Second War.

Lugar conocido: el punto del rastreo del.en: Known location: the game's tracking dot tells whether something is there now.

Lya ahora es una loba negra de cuerpo co.en: Lya is now a full-body black she-wolf with 39 animation frames: she sits, runs, chases her tail, yawns and sleeps curled up.

Lya apunta aquí tus pasos grandes: tu pr.en: Lya writes your big steps here: your first dungeon, your levels, your first mount and more.

Lya apunta tus pasos grandes (tu primera.en: Lya writes down your big steps (your first dungeon, your levels, your first mount...) and celebrates every new page.

Lya descansa. La llamas con /alfa lya o.en: Lya rests. Call her with /alfa lya or /alfa ayuda whenever you like.

Lya en las mazmorras, con ánimo, su salc.en: Lya in dungeons, with moods, her sausage and her goodbye; and she shows you Alfa in 5 steps.

Lya es quien olfatea los raros y los tes.en: Lya is the one who sniffs out rares and treasures: her card has "Go hunt", "Its page" and "Target it".

Lya festeja cuando un lobo de tu hermand.en: Lya celebrates when a wolf in your guild reaches level 60, gets their first mount or hunts a rare.

Lya fue una gran perrita: noble, leal y.en: Lya was a wonderful little dog: noble, loyal and always beside her family, the chubby, pampered darling of the house. Alfa remembers her that way, as the she-wolf who looks after the pack and never leaves anyone behind.

Lya guarda la historia de cada misión qu.en: Lya saves the story of every quest you take, even if you accept it without reading. You follow the arrow: she remembers everything.

Lya lleva tu historia, aprende qué conse.en: Lya keeps your story, learns which tips you no longer want and tells you about your trades.

Lya platica mucho más: lore de Warcraft,.en: Lya chats a lot more: Warcraft lore, facts about every zone, your race, your class and your professions, and tips for events and farming. And she loves sausages!

Lya platica según la hora del día, las f.en: Lya chats about the time of day, Azeroth's holidays and the zone you're in.

Lya recuerda lo que te dijo, tiene una t.en: Lya remembers what she told you, has a key for her button and tells you about your hunting week and your best day.

Lya saluda a tu mascota y, si eres cazad.en: Lya greets your pet and, if you're a hunter, tells you when it's hungry or unhappy.

Lya se fue a descansar. Vuelve con /alfa.en: Lya went to rest. Bring her back with /alfa lya.

Lya se queda calladita una hora. Aquí si.en: Lya stays quiet for an hour. She's still here, looking after you.

Lya se queda en tu pantalla: consejos co.en: Lya stays on your screen: short tips, stories and shortcuts to all of Alfa.

Lya te cuenta cuánto tardaron, cuántas v.en: Lya tells you how long it took, how many times you fell and the best thing you got.

Lya te enseña la ventana de Alfa en 5 pa.en: Lya shows you the Alfa window in 5 steps
Lya shows you the Alfa window in 5 steps. Also with /alfa recorrido.

Lya te enseña la ventana de Alfa paso a.en: Lya shows you the Alfa window step by step
Lya shows you the Alfa window step by step. Also with /alfa recorrido.

Lya te enseña tu clase y te ayuda al mor.en: Lya teaches your class and helps when you die; backups, diagnostics and a lighter Alfa.

Lya te entiende sin acentos, te cuenta d.en: Lya understands you without accents, tells you things even while hidden and her menu says what it will do.

Lya te guía, un asistente más sencillo y.en: Lya guides you, a simpler setup and dens

Lya tiene mucho que contar.en: Lya has a lot to tell

Lya volvió. Dale clic cuando quieras un.en: Lya is back. Click her whenever you want a tip.

Lya vuelve a contarte sus consejos desde.en: Lya will tell you her tips again from the start.

Lya vuelve a decirte todos esos consejos.en: Lya tells you all those tips again.

Lya vuelve a decirte todos los consejos.en: Lya will tell you all the tips you muted again.

Lya, la loba negra que te acompaña, está.en: Lya, the black wolf at your side, is in memory of Toxic's dog. She tells you about every zone, gives you tips and, of course, loves sausages.

Lya, la manada y tus récords.en: Lya, the pack and your records

Lya, tu guía, la flecha, los avisos, la.en: Lya, your guide, the arrow, the alerts, fishing and the Combat and Healing frames: drag them wherever you like. Also with /alfa acomodar.

Lánzalo antes de la siguiente pelea..en: Cast it before the next fight.

Maestría elemental: tu siguiente hechizo.en: Elemental Mastery: your next spell is a free critical.

Maiev Cantosombrío fue la carcelera de I.en: Maiev Shadowsong was Illidan's jailer for ten thousand years, at the head of the Watchers.

Mal'Ganis, el señor del terror, guió la.en: Mal'Ganis, the dreadlord, guided the plague in Lordaeron. Arthas chased him all the way to Northrend, and that hunt was his undoing.

Maldiciones y daño con el tiempo: pones.en: Curses and damage over time: you put your spells on and the monster dies on its own while you move to the next.

Only the essentials in sight: Today, Route, World, Bags, Talents and Lya, and fewer notices. The rest is still there when you look for it.

Solo lo que tu clase puede usar y le con.en: Only what your class can use and suits your specialization.

Solo él ve tu nivel, tu zona y tu misión.en: Only they see your level, zone and current quest.

Son %s más que venderlo todo al comercia.en: That's %s more than vendoring it all.

Sonido con el juego en segundo plano.en: Sound with the game in the background

Sonidos suaves del juego: nada de voces.en: Soft game sounds: no voices and no repeated sounds.

Stromgarde, la heredera de Strom, resist.en: Stromgarde, Strom's heir, barely holds on: trolls, ogres and the Syndicate fight over its ruins.

Su rayo salta de un jugador a otro: sepá.en: His lightning jumps between players: spread out a little.

Sube tu profesión o junta sus materiales.en: Level your profession or gather its materials where there are the most.

Sube tus oficios con lo que tienes cerca.en: Level your professions with what's nearby.

Subidón de adrenalina: recuperas energía.en: Adrenaline Rush: you regain energy much faster.

Subir como tanque: más lento que Armas,.en: Leveling as a tank: slower than Arms, but you almost never die, you pull several monsters at once and you arrive ready to tank any dungeon.

Subir de nivel, profesiones, hacer oro o.en: Level up, professions, make gold or dungeons: two clicks and Alfa takes you there.

Subir de nivel, profesiones, oro o mazmo.en: Level up, professions, gold or dungeons.

Succionar vida: daño con el tiempo que t.en: Siphon Life: damage over time that heals you.

Suelta lo que traes en el cursor y vuelv.en: Drop what you're holding on the cursor and try again.

Suelta una llave que abre una puerta más.en: He drops a key that opens a door further on: someone has to pick it up.

Suelta una nube de enfermedad a su alred.en: He releases a disease cloud around him: remove diseases.

Suelta una ola de fuego a su alrededor:.en: He sends out a ring of fire around him: ranged players, stay away from him.

Suena ahora, aunque el aullido esté apag.en: Plays it now, even with the howl turned off.

Sueño con una montaña de salchichas... y.en: I dream of a mountain of sausages... with me on top, happy.

Sugiere con la prioridad de Alfa para tu.en: Suggest with Alfa's priority for your class. Off, it uses Blizzard's assist when the game gives a suggestion Alfa can read; in combat Forever hides it, so Alfa's is used there.

Sulfuras es el martillo de Ragnaros. Con.en: Sulfuras is Ragnaros's hammer. With its eye, the bravest can forge a legendary version.

Suma tus sesiones de hoy con este person.en: Adds up today's sessions with this character.

Suma «conseguir este objeto» a tu plan d.en: Adds «get this item» to your current plan (or a new one).

Sus bolas de sombra pegan mucho: interrú.en: His shadow bolts hit hard: interrupt him.

Sus consejos te esperan en Alfa..en: Its tips are waiting in Alfa.

Sus jefes, su botín, sus misiones y cómo.en: Its bosses, its loot, its quests and how to get there.

Sus rayos saltan entre jugadores: sepáre.en: Her lightning jumps between players: spread out.

Sylvanas era hermana de Alleria y de Ver.en: Sylvanas was the sister of Alleria and Vereesa Windrunner. Today she leads the Forsaken with a firm hand.

Sylvanas recibe en el Barrio Real de Ent.en: Sylvanas holds court in the Undercity's Royal Quarter, with Varimathras at her side.

Sylvanas tiene dos hermanas: Alleria, qu.en: Sylvanas has two sisters: Alleria, who went beyond the Dark Portal, and Vereesa, who married the mage Rhonin.

Sí, poco a poco: en cada pelea Alfa apre.en: Yes, little by little: in each fight Alfa learns how often the boss uses its attacks. Next time you'll see a small line like "Next Breath in ~15 s". The first fight says nothing: it's learning.

Sí, que la manada me vea.en: Yes, let the pack see me

Sí: Alfa, Clásico WoW o Cristal, con tu.en: Yes: Alfa, Classic WoW or Crystal, with your colour. It can also dress the chat, the minimap and the bars.

Sí: con /alfa limpia, o con tu tecla de.en: Yes: with /alfa limpia, or your clean screen key, I hide the chat, the minimap and whatever else you pick. Once more and it all comes back.

Sí: con el modo foco, en mazmorras y en.en: Yes: with focus mode, in dungeons and in combat I get small and quiet. I come back afterwards. It's in my settings.

Sí: en Ajustes > Estilo y sonido elige «.en: Yes: in Settings > Style and sound pick "Simple" under "How you see Alfa". I keep only the essentials in sight and notify you less.

Sí: en las asignaciones de teclas del ju.en: Yes: in the game's key bindings, in the Alfa section, give "Ask Lya" a key and another to "What Lya offers", which does what her button does.
Yes: in the game's key bindings, in the Alfa section, give "Ask Lya" a key.

Sí: en tus atajos de Alfa ponle una tecl.en: Yes: in your Alfa shortcuts, give "Ask Lya" a key and another to "What Lya offers", which does what her button does.

Sí: en «Mentor», pulsa «Adoptar» junto a.en: Yes: under "Mentor", press "Adopt" next to a wolf 10 levels lower. If they accept, you see how they're doing and I tell you if they get stuck.

Sí: escribe /alfa nota y tu texto, o usa.en: Yes: type /alfa nota and your text, or use "Note here" in La Jauría. It shows on your map where you stand; one click and the arrow takes you.

Sí: sale «[Misión] está lista para entre.en: Yes: "[Quest] is ready to turn in" and "Quest complete!" show in group chat. Solo, they show just for you.

Talentos te dice cuál sigue..en: Talents tells you which one is next.

Talentos: qué poner ahora y tu build (/a.en: Talents: what to take now and your build (/alfa builds aplicar | equipo | compartir)

Talentos: qué poner ahora y tu plan de t.en: Talents: what to take now and your build (/alfa builds aplicar | equipo | compartir)

También dentro de cuevas, criptas y edif.en: Also inside caves, crypts and buildings.

También el de venenos, sangrados y efect.en: Also from poisons, bleeds and lasting effects.

También está en el menú de opciones del.en: Also in the game's options menu.

También las que no son de la guía (de es.en: Also the ones that are not in the guide ("Accept guide quests" handles those). Grey quests are left alone, quests that ask for gold, currency or trade goods are not turned in, and when there are several rewards you choose. Hold Shift to do it yourself.

También las que no son de tu guía.en: Also the ones outside your guide

También usa Alfa: salúdalo..en: They use Alfa too: say hi.

Taretha Foxton, una muchacha humana de D.en: Taretha Foxton, a human girl from Durnholde, was Thrall's friend and helped him escape.

Tarjeta de habilidades nuevas al subir d.en: New skills card on level up

Te abrimos un susurro para %s con tu men.en: We opened a whisper to %s with your message. Check it and press Enter to send it.

Te atacan con la caña en la mano.en: You're under attack with your pole in hand

Te avisa cuando tu clase tiene algo que.en: Tells you when your class has something to use right now, like an ability that just lit up.

Te aviso con «Regalárselo»: abre el come.en: I tell you with "Give it to them": it opens the trade if they're next to you, or leaves their name in the mail. They need to share their class and level.

Te cambié las armas de «%s»; lo demás, a.en: I swapped the weapons of "%s"; the rest when the fight ends.

Te conviertes en felino: mucho daño cuer.en: You turn into a cat: lots of melee damage, and you can prowl.

Te conviertes en foca: nadas rápido y re.en: You turn into a seal: you swim fast and breathe underwater.

Te conviertes en guepardo y corres más r.en: You turn into a cheetah and run faster. Outdoors only.

Te conviertes en lobo y corres más rápid.en: You turn into a wolf and run faster. Just like me!

Te conviertes en oso: más armadura y más.en: You turn into a bear: more armor and health. For tanking and holding on.

Te cura toda la vida a cambio de tu maná.en: Heals you to full in exchange for your mana. Save it for an emergency.

Te da poder de ataque: cada golpe pega m.en: Gives you attack power: every hit lands harder. For warriors it also raises shield block.

Te damos la bienvenida a Alfa, el todo e.en: Welcome to Alfa, La Jauría's all-in-one.

Te dice qué comprar a tu nivel y te llev.en: It tells you what to buy at your level and takes you to the nearest food vendor. Water only if you use mana.

Te dice qué pieza está por romperse, par.en: Tells you which piece is about to break, so you repair it in time.

Te enseña Pesca y sus rangos. También ve.en: Teaches Fishing and its ranks. Also sells the basic pole.

Te falta Bendición de poderío: más poder.en: Blessing of Might is missing: more attack power.

Te falta Fuego interior: más armadura..en: Inner Fire is missing: more armor.

Te falta Grito de batalla: más poder de.en: Battle Shout is missing: more attack power for you and your group.

Te falta ira: Ira sangrienta te la da gr.en: You're short on rage: Bloodrage gives it for free.

Te falta la forma de lechúcico lunar: má.en: Moonkin Form is missing: more damage with your spells.

Te falta una bendición: Poderío da más p.en: A blessing is missing: Might gives more attack power.

Te falta una bendición: Sabiduría te dev.en: A blessing is missing: Wisdom gives you mana back.

Te guardé %d cosa mientras tanto..en: I saved %d thing for you meanwhile.

Te guardé %d cosas mientras tanto..en: I saved %d things for you meanwhile.

Te haces el muerto y los enemigos te olv.en: You play dead and enemies forget you. Your best way out when things go wrong.

Te la dio y la recibe %s.en: Given by and turned in to %s

Te lleva a las misiones de tu ruta que y.en: Takes you to your route's quests you can already take.

Te llevo a entregarlas todas en el mejor.en: I'll take you to turn them all in, in the best order.

Te llevo a la mejor fuente. Recuerda que.en: Taking you to the best source. Remember that a mount needs level, riding and gold.

Te llevo a quien recibe cada una y recog.en: I take you to whoever takes each one, and you pick up what follows.

Te lo enseña cualquier instructor de pes.en: Any fishing trainer teaches it. Until you learn it, your skill won't go past the cap.

Te lo pido de corazón: nunca desuelles a.en: I ask you from the heart: never skin a wolf in front of me, okay?

Te pone tus armas y el resto de tu equip.en: Puts on your weapons and the rest of your gear, and closes fishing mode.

Te queda muy poco maná: Estimular lo rec.en: You're very low on mana: Innervate restores it.

Te queda muy poco maná: Evocación lo rec.en: You're very low on mana: Evocation restores it.

Te queda poca XP descansada.en: Your rested XP is running low

Te queda poca comida y agua.en: You're low on food and water

Te queda poco maná y te sobra vida: camb.en: You're low on mana with health to spare: trade health for mana.

Te queda poco maná: cambia vida por maná.en: You're low on mana: trade health for mana.

Te queda poco maná: usa tu varita..en: You're low on mana: use your wand.

Te quedan %d espacios en las bolsas. Ven.en: You have %d bag slots left. Sell the grey items or store things in the bank.

Te quedaste sin comida ni agua.en: You ran out of food and water

Te saluda según la hora, comenta la zona.en: She greets you by time of day, comments on the zone and sometimes sits to beg with her little bone.

Te señala lo que cuesta menos de lo que.en: Points out what costs less than it usually does, or what earns a profit when disenchanted. The purchase is always yours.

Te sobra ira y hay varios enemigos: tu s.en: You have rage to spare and several enemies: your next swing hits two.

Te sobra ira: gástala en tu siguiente go.en: You have rage to spare: spend it on your next swing.

Te sobra ira: tu siguiente golpe es más.en: You have rage to spare: your next swing is stronger.

Te teletransporta a tu ciudad. Necesitas.en: Teleports you to your city. You need a Rune of Teleportation.

Te teletransportas unos metros hacia ade.en: Teleports you a few yards forward. Escapes roots and stuns.

Te vuelve inmune un rato. Úsalo para sal.en: Makes you immune for a while. Use it to save yourself or to escape.

Te vuelves invisible al caminar. Acércat.en: You turn invisible while you walk. Sneak up unseen and choose how to start.

Tecla para abrir o cerrar el modo.en: Key to open or close the mode

Tecla para volver a tus armas.en: Key to go back to your weapons

Teldrassil es tan grande que entre sus r.en: Teldrassil is so huge that its branches hold hills, lakes and caves.

Teldrassil es un árbol del mundo que los.en: Teldrassil is a world tree the night elves planted without the dragons' blessing. That's why it didn't grant them immortality.

Teldrassil se plantó para recuperar la i.en: Teldrassil was planted to regain immortality, but without the dragons' blessing. Something about it isn't right.

Teldrassil siempre tiene una luz suave,.en: Teldrassil always has a soft light, as if the tree itself were looking after us.

Ten siempre a mano una poción de vida: e.en: Always keep a health potion at hand: this build doesn't forgive mistakes.

Tengo muchas misiones a medias, ¿qué hag.en: I have lots of half-done quests, what do I do?

Tengo poco tiempo, ¿qué hago?.en: I don't have much time, what should I do?

Terenas Menethil, rey de Lordaeron, unió.en: Terenas Menethil, king of Lordaeron, united the kingdoms into the Alliance of Lordaeron. Years later, his own son Arthas killed him on his throne.

Termina la configuración para usar Alfa.en: Finish the setup to use Alfa (2 minutes).

Terminado: cumpliste todas sus metas..en: Finished: you met all its goals.

Terminar la cadena de Lord Valthalak tam.en: Finishing Lord Valthalak's chain is also a Legacy challenge.

Terminaste 1 de sus misiones: entrégala.en: You finished 1 of its quests: hand it in and pick up what follows.

Textos y cajas mejor alineados en las ve.en: Better aligned texts and boxes across Alfa's windows.

Theradras, la princesa de la tierra, es.en: Theradras, the earth princess, is Therazane's daughter. She loved Zaetar, son of Cenarius, and their children, the centaurs, ended up killing him.

Theramore la fundó Jaina Valiente con lo.en: Jaina Proudmoore founded Theramore with the humans who left Lordaeron before it fell.

Thrall eligió esta tierra roja y seca pa.en: Thrall chose this dry red land so the free orcs could start over, far from the humans' internment camps.

Thrall es el chamán más famoso: los elem.en: Thrall is the most famous shaman: the elements answer him like no one else.

Thrall gobierna la Horda desde Orgrimmar.en: Thrall rules the Horde from Orgrimmar as warchief, with an eye on peace.

Thrall liberó a los orcos de los campos.en: Thrall freed the orcs from the internment camps with the help of Grom Hellscream and Orgrim Doomhammer.

Thrall nació en Draenor, hijo de Durotan.en: Thrall was born on Draenor, son of Durotan and Draka. Aedelas Blackmoore found him as a baby and named him «Thrall», which means slave.

Thrall quiere que los orcos recuperen el.en: Thrall wants the orcs to win back the honor they had before the demonic corruption.

Tiempo máximo entre los dos clics. Súbel.en: The longest time between the two clicks. Raise it if your double-clicks don't cast.

Tiene cuatro partes que se hacen por sep.en: It has four parts done separately: Graveyard, Library, Armory and Cathedral, from easiest to hardest.

Tiene un perjuicio que puedes quitar:.en: They have a debuff you can remove:

Tienes %d de %d casillas de bolsa en el.en: You have %d of %d bank bag slots.

Tienes %d misiones listas para entregar.en: You have %d quests ready to hand in

Tienes %d piezas mejores para pescar en.en: You have %d better fishing pieces in your bags.
